account.refusal.storesFull.source: Your Stores hold {max, number} of that already.

account.refusal.storesGold.source: What you bought with gold is not used there, in your Stores or out of them: it goes to your pack or back on the market for gold.

account.refusal.storesShort.source: Your Stores do not hold that many.

account.refusal.stripeDown.source: Stripe did not answer. Try again in a minute.

account.refusal.subjectLong.source: A subject is at most {max} characters.

account.refusal.subs.source: The Spire could not read that company.

account.refusal.taken.source: You took the Resonant Maul today. Fell the Colossus again tomorrow for another.

account.refusal.termsStale.source: The Terms of Service or the Privacy Policy has changed. Reload the game (or update the app) to read the current version, then tick the boxes again.

account.refusal.termsUnaccepted.source: Tick both boxes to agree to the Terms of Service and the Privacy Policy.

account.refusal.tier.source: That is no dungeon the Spire knows.

account.refusal.titheThisWeek.source: The Tithe has been set this week already. It may change again after the Turning.

account.refusal.toSelf.source: You cannot send a letter to yourself.

account.refusal.tooLarge.source: That save is too big to back up.

account.refusal.tooManyCharacters.source: You have as many online characters as an account may hold. Delete one to make room.

account.refusal.tooManySaves.source: Your cloud backup is full. Delete a save there to make room.

account.refusal.tradeHeld.source: This character's trading, gathering and crafting are frozen. The notice shown when it froze says why, and until when.

account.refusal.tradeSpent.source: That trade has already ended. Nothing changed hands.

account.refusal.unknown.source: The realm did not answer. Join again to see how it ended.

account.refusal.unproven.source: The Spire opens only to those who have closed a Dagon's Breach.

account.refusal.vaultGoods.source: That piece cannot go in the vault. It is no longer in your pack, or it has to stay with its owner (a quest item, a summoned item or the Materials Bag).

account.refusal.vaultGrantOver.source: You cannot give more vault access than you have.

account.refusal.voteOwn.source: You cannot vote on your own home, or on the hall of your own guild.

account.refusal.voteRate.source: You have voted on too many homes this hour. Try again later.

account.refusal.voteYoung.source: An account must have had its username and password for a week to vote on homes.

account.refusal.wager.source: The Spire could not read that Wager.

account.refusal.wedNoLine.source: Only a character of a house (Project Legacy) can be wed in the realm.

account.refusal.wedPartner.source: They cannot marry now. They are already married, belong to no house, or are no longer the one who stood with you.

account.refusal.wedSpent.source: That wedding was not yours to answer.

account.refusal.writBudget.source: That is past the Officers' writ budget for this week. The Guildmaster sets it on the Guild tab.

account.refusal.writBusy.source: Your last writ is still being settled. Try again in a moment.

account.refusal.writCap.source: You have filled {max} writs today, the most a day allows.

account.refusal.writElsewhere.source: That writ is delivered at the boards of the region that posted it.

account.refusal.writGone.source: That writ is no longer posted.

account.refusal.writMoved.source: Someone else delivered first. Check the writ again.

account.refusal.writOwnGuild.source: Officers and the Guildmaster can take from the guild Stores, so they cannot deliver to the guild's own writs.

account.refusal.writPay.source: A guild writ can pay at most 1.5 times the material's worth per unit.

account.refusal.writRate.source: You have reached the hourly limit for writs and commissions ({posts} posted, {acts} other actions). Try again later.

account.refusal.writShort.source: That writ needs fewer than that now.

account.refusal.writTaken.source: Someone else has already filled that writ.

account.refusal.writsClosed.source: Guild writs and commissions are not open to this account.

account.refusal.yardCap.source: A yard holds at most {max} pieces. Remove one to place another.

account.slots.hint.source: Point at a choice to see it on you. Press it to wear it.

account.slots.notHeld.source: Not yours yet. Point at it to try it on.

account.slots.portalNone.source: Your portals open as the violet vortex.

account.slots.setLook.source: Every piece of the set at once.

account.slots.weaponNote.source: It shows on the weapon in your hand.

account.wear.worn.source: Worn. Press to take it off.

armory.look.ashbound.source: A chain of glowing iron winds round the arms, from the shoulders to the wrists. Ash falls from it.

armory.look.breachbrand.source: Fire runs along the weapon from the grip to the point, and drips from the tip.

armory.look.burningcrown.source: A circlet of molten iron, with horns of flame and a door of white fire at the brow. Embers lift off the points.

armory.look.cinderstride.source: Low flames lick up the shins from a ring of coal at each ankle. Each step leaves an ember on the ground that burns out.

armory.look.crystalspurs.source: Small spurs of crystal along both arms, each a different size. Their colors shift slowly from amethyst to aqua to rose.

armory.look.emberheart.source: A cracked coal burns in the chest and beats like a heart. Fire runs out along its veins with every beat.

armory.look.eternalarmlets.source: Engraved bands of blue-violet fire circle the upper arms and the wrists. Flames lick up off them.

armory.look.eternaledge.source: A blade of blue-violet light runs along the weapon's edge. Sparks trail from it when you swing.

armory.look.eternalgreaves.source: Blue-violet fire wraps the legs from the knee to the foot, under a lattice of light. Sparks rise as you walk.

armory.look.eternalhalo.source: A band of blue-violet fire turns over the head, runes round it and the Origin's spark at its front.

armory.look.eternalset.source: All five Eternal pieces at once: the Halo, the Sigil, the Armlets, the Greaves and the Edge.

armory.look.eternalsigil.source: The Origin's dragon of light circles the spark on the chest, biting its own tail. A slow light runs round it.

armory.look.insigniaarmlet.source: A gilt band round the left upper arm, enamelled in your guild's colors, with its arms on a shield of beaten gold.

aurumCache.empty.source: The coffer is empty. It fills again on Monday.

aurumCache.here.source: An Aurum coffer is hidden in this dungeon.

bank.houseOffer.source: This is your house {n} of {count} in this town.

bank.housesFull.source: You already own {max} houses in this region. You must sell one before we can sell you another.

body.face.curated.source: the curated table names both halves - nothing measured

body.outfit.second.source: a second outfit - the first ({first}) is the one drawn

body.outfit.unbound.source: none of it bound - drawn without it

bossTraits.rule.bladeturning.source: Blades and arrows do half damage. Blunt weapons and fists do full.

bossTraits.rule.curbing.source: No single blow takes more than {pct}% of its health.

bossTraits.rule.flameproof.source: Fire spells do a quarter of their damage.

bossTraits.rule.frostproof.source: Frost spells do a quarter of their damage.

bossTraits.rule.spellproof.source: Magic spells do a quarter of their damage.

bossTraits.rule.stoneskin.source: Blunt weapons and fists do half damage. Blades do full.

bossTraits.rule.stormproof.source: Shock spells do a quarter of their damage.

bossTraits.rule.thorned.source: Some of every weapon blow that lands comes back at you.

bossTraits.rule.venomproof.source: Poison spells do a quarter of their damage.

bossTraits.rule.warded.source: A ward takes every blow first. It grows back if you stop hitting it.

bossTraits.rule.wrathful.source: It hits much harder once the fight has gone on for {s} seconds.

broker.armory.kept.source: Paid from your account’s embers. Wear it here or on your account card, in its own slot.

broker.owed.source: No answer from the account service. Your embers are held, and the Broker settles the sale on your next visit.

cabin.refusal.enemies.source: You cannot enter the cabin with enemies nearby.

captain.no.points.source: Reaching this star costs {need} {need, plural, one {point} other {points}}. You have {left}. You get one point per captain level after the first.

captain.no.way.source: This star isn't connected to any of your stars.

captain.page.what.source: Master stars improve your ships' speed, steering, cargo, hull and trade prices. Commander stars improve guns, shot and boarding. Your captain's level also opens metal refits, from Steel at level 3 up to Daedric.

captain.sky.commanderLore.source: Combat: gun reload and accuracy, grapeshot, chain shot and heated shot, and boarding.

captain.sky.hint.source: Click a star to take it and the stars on the way to it · Right-click to remove · Drag to pan · Scroll to zoom · H: back to the Helm

captain.sky.hintTouch.source: Tap a star to see it, tap again to take it · Hold a star to remove it · Drag to pan · Pinch to zoom

captain.sky.levelTip.source: A captain's experience comes from sinking and capturing ships, beating off boarders, claiming prizes, finishing contracts, distance sailed, treasure charts, charting isles and selling goods at the exchange.

captain.sky.masterLore.source: Seamanship: sails, oars, steering, cargo, trade and repairs.

captain.sky.noPoints.source: You gain one point for each captain level after the first. Earn experience at sea: sink or capture a ship, finish a contract, or simply sail.

captain.sky.none.source: No stars taken yet. Start next to the Helm.

captain.sky.note.source: Stars apply to all of your ships. Removing or changing stars is free.

captain.sky.oreNote.source: From level 3, shipwrights can refit a ship past grade III with Steel. Each later metal, up to Daedric, needs a higher level.

captain.sky.pointsTip.source: One point per level after the first.

captain.sky.set.source: Stars saved. They apply to all of your ships.

captain.sky.unaccepted.source: You have unaccepted changes. Press {accept} to keep them, or close again to discard them.

captain.sky.unacceptedLeave.source: You have unaccepted changes. Press {accept} to keep them, or leave again to discard them.

captain.tip.backAfter.source: Right-click to remove it and {n, plural, one {the star} other {the # stars}} after it.

captain.tip.helm.source: Everyone starts with the Helm. Take a star next to it.

captain.tip.take.source: Click to take: {n} {n, plural, one {point} other {points}}.

cards.iliac.setup.keepsWhy.source: The loser pays one from their deck

cards.iliac.setup.rankedWhy.source: Counts on the season board. Uses your realm character's cards.

cards.iliacSet.ancientLich.flavor.source: It remembers the First Era as you remember breakfast.

cards.iliacSet.ancientLich.rules.source: Reveal: destroy the weakest enemy unit here. Ongoing: your undead units have +1 power.

cards.iliacSet.ancientVampire.flavor.source: The bloodlines of the Bay all lead back to one cellar.

cards.iliacSet.ancientVampire.rules.source: End of turn: the weakest enemy unit here loses 1 power and this gains +1 power.

cards.iliacSet.animateDead.flavor.source: The graveyard is a barracks, if you know the words.

cards.iliacSet.archer.flavor.source: One arrow, for the one who cannot dodge it.

cards.iliacSet.archer.rules.source: Reveal: the weakest enemy unit here loses 1 power.

cards.iliacSet.azura.flavor.source: Dusk and dawn, and every one of hers between.

cards.iliacSet.azurasStar.flavor.source: A soul gem that never empties.

cards.iliacSet.azurasStar.rules.source: Draw 2 cards and gain +2 magicka next turn.

cards.iliacSet.banishDaedra.flavor.source: Back through the gate that let it in, and the gate shut behind it.

cards.iliacSet.banishDaedra.rules.source: Destroy the weakest enemy daedra unit here.

cards.iliacSet.betony.flavor.source: An island two crowns claim, and both send spies.

cards.iliacSet.betony.rules.source: After a card is revealed here, its owner draws a card.

cards.iliacSet.boethiah.flavor.source: The Prince of Plots favors whoever is still standing.

cards.iliacSet.boethiah.rules.source: Ongoing: your warrior units have +2 power.

cards.iliacSet.brassRemnant.flavor.source: It keeps the Hour in the Abyss. Every turn of the Hour turns it harder.

cards.iliacSet.brassRemnant.rules.source: End of turn: this gains +1 power.

cards.iliacSet.castleDaggerfall.flavor.source: The court's wards hold every spell at the gate.

cards.iliacSet.centaur.flavor.source: The herds of the hills answer its horn.

cards.iliacSet.centaur.rules.source: Ongoing: your beast units here have +1 power.

cards.iliacSet.chrysamere.flavor.source: The Paladin's Blade chooses the worthy.

cards.iliacSet.chrysamere.rules.source: Your strongest unit here gains +4 power.

cards.iliacSet.clavicusVile.flavor.source: A bargain. Read the small print later.

cards.iliacSet.daedraLord.flavor.source: It never comes through the gate alone.

cards.iliacSet.daedraSeducer.flavor.source: Look her in the eye and see what you were.

cards.iliacSet.daedraSeducer.rules.source: Reveal: turn the weakest enemy unit here into a Rat.

cards.iliacSet.daedroth.flavor.source: Its jaws close on the slowest.

cards.iliacSet.daedroth.rules.source: End of turn: the weakest enemy unit here loses 1 power.

cards.iliacSet.daggerfall.flavor.source: The crown city, and its knights ride for it.

cards.iliacSet.darkBrotherhoodAssassin.f.source: The contract was signed before you sat down.

cards.iliacSet.darkBrotherhoodAssassin.r.source: Reveal: destroy the weakest enemy unit here.

cards.iliacSet.demonologist.flavor.source: What is summoned on the Witches' Festival may plague Tamriel for eons.

cards.iliacSet.dragonling.flavor.source: Small, for a dragon. Not small for a hall.

cards.iliacSet.dragonling.rules.source: Reveal: enemy units here lose 2 power.

cards.iliacSet.dreugh.flavor.source: The Bay's floor walks up onto the strand.

cards.iliacSet.dreugh.rules.source: Reveal: the weakest enemy unit here loses 1 power.

cards.iliacSet.egArmsmaster.flavor.source: Raised by the Kyn, he still teaches the sword. The lesson is the same.

cards.iliacSet.egArmsmaster.rules.source: Ongoing: your warrior units here have +2 power.

cards.iliacSet.egCairnkeeper.flavor.source: Every soul pays the tithe. The Keeper counts them all.

cards.iliacSet.egColossus.flavor.source: The Battlemages built it to hold the Wellhead. The Kyn broke its chains.

cards.iliacSet.egColossus.rules.source: End of turn: this loses 1 power.

cards.iliacSet.egDusk.flavor.source: Winged by Dagon. Her shadow comes before her, and then she does.

cards.iliacSet.egDusk.rules.source: End of turn: the weakest enemy unit here loses 1 power.

cards.iliacSet.egGaroth.flavor.source: Clan-lord of the Wellhead. Every Kyn in the Spire answers his muster.

cards.iliacSet.egGaroth.rules.source: Ongoing: your units here have +1 power.

cards.iliacSet.egGrath.flavor.source: The Kyn loosed him on the Galleries. The bridges still smoke where he ran.

cards.iliacSet.egGrath.rules.source: Reveal: the strongest enemy unit here loses 3 power.

cards.iliacSet.egIlthys.flavor.source: She took the Galleries in a night, and burned the banners she did not keep.

cards.iliacSet.egIlthys.rules.source: Reveal: your daedra units gain +1 power.

cards.iliacSet.egMorvayn.flavor.source: He chains the souls of the Cairn, and wears them.

cards.iliacSet.egMorvayn.rules.source: End of turn: the strongest enemy unit here loses 1 power.

cards.iliacSet.egSeyth.flavor.source: In her vault the moon turns black, and the mirrors keep what they show.

cards.iliacSet.egSeyth.rules.source: Reveal: the strongest enemy unit loses 2 power.

cards.iliacSet.egSpellmaster.flavor.source: He sets the Examination still. Nobody has passed it since 3E 398.

cards.iliacSet.egStalker.flavor.source: It drinks the dark of the Shade, and whatever stands in it.

cards.iliacSet.egStalker.rules.source: Reveal: the weakest enemy unit here loses 3 power.

cards.iliacSet.egTwins.flavor.source: Vael and Isk. Strike one, and the other remembers it.

cards.iliacSet.egTwins.rules.source: Reveal: your units here gain +1 power.

cards.iliacSet.egWyrm.flavor.source: It swims the molten deep, and surfaces only to burn.

cards.iliacSet.egWyrm.rules.source: Reveal: enemy units here lose 1 power.

cards.iliacSet.evermor.flavor.source: A rich town pays its friends quickly.

cards.iliacSet.evermor.rules.source: After a card is revealed here, its owner gains +1 magicka next turn.

cards.iliacSet.fightersGuildChampion.fla.source: The guildhall's best blade, and its loudest voice.

cards.iliacSet.fightersGuildChampion.rul.source: Reveal: your warrior units here gain +2 power.

cards.iliacSet.fightersGuildSwordsman.fl.source: Paid by the contract, loyal to the man beside him.

cards.iliacSet.fightersGuildSwordsman.ru.source: Ongoing: your warrior units here have +1 power.

cards.iliacSet.fireAtronach.flavor.source: The room is warm. Then it is ash.

cards.iliacSet.fireAtronach.rules.source: Reveal: enemy units here lose 1 power.

cards.iliacSet.fireDaedra.flavor.source: Its blade was forged in the Deadlands, and it is burning still.

cards.iliacSet.fireDaedra.rules.source: Reveal: the strongest enemy unit here loses 2 power.

cards.iliacSet.fireball.flavor.source: Aim at the biggest. You will not miss.

cards.iliacSet.fireball.rules.source: The strongest enemy unit here loses 3 power.

cards.iliacSet.fleshAtronach.flavor.source: Stitched from what the summoner had to hand.

cards.iliacSet.fleshAtronach.rules.source: Ongoing: your atronach units here have +1 power.

cards.iliacSet.frostDaedra.flavor.source: Where it walks, the ale freezes in the cup.

cards.iliacSet.frostDaedra.rules.source: Reveal: enemy units here lose 1 power.

cards.iliacSet.frostbite.rules.source: The weakest enemy unit here loses 2 power.

cards.iliacSet.gargoyle.flavor.source: Stone keeps watch over the soft.

cards.iliacSet.gargoyle.rules.source: Reveal: your weakest unit here gains +2 power.

cards.iliacSet.ghost.flavor.source: The bravest feel the cold first.

cards.iliacSet.ghost.rules.source: Reveal: the strongest enemy unit here loses 2 power.

cards.iliacSet.giant.flavor.source: Where it steps, friend and foe alike are trodden.

cards.iliacSet.giantBat.flavor.source: It never stays where your torch is.

cards.iliacSet.giantBat.rules.source: End of turn: move this to the next holding round the table with room.

cards.iliacSet.giantScorpion.flavor.source: The Alik'r sends its regards on eight legs.

cards.iliacSet.giantScorpion.rules.source: Reveal: the strongest enemy unit here loses 1 power.

cards.iliacSet.glenmorilWitch.flavor.source: The Wyrd keep the moors. Trespassers leave on four legs.

cards.iliacSet.glenmorilWitch.rules.source: Reveal: turn the weakest enemy unit here into a Rat.

cards.iliacSet.grizzlyBear.flavor.source: It comes down the Wrothgarian pass at a charge, and it does not charge twice.

cards.iliacSet.grizzlyBear.rules.source: End of turn: this loses 1 power.

cards.iliacSet.harpy.flavor.source: Its shriek reaches every man in the hall.

cards.iliacSet.harpy.rules.source: Reveal: enemy units here lose 1 power.

cards.iliacSet.heal.rules.source: Your weakest unit here gains +2 power.

cards.iliacSet.hircine.flavor.source: The Huntsman runs with his pack.

cards.iliacSet.hircine.rules.source: Ongoing: your beast units have +2 power.

cards.iliacSet.hostOfTheHorn.flavor.source: One blast, and the whole line takes heart.

cards.iliacSet.hostOfTheHorn.rules.source: Reveal: your units here gain +1 power.

cards.iliacSet.iceAtronach.flavor.source: The weak freeze where they stand.

cards.iliacSet.iceAtronach.rules.source: Reveal: the weakest enemy unit here loses 2 power.

cards.iliacSet.imp.flavor.source: A small spite with a full purse of magicka.

cards.iliacSet.ironAtronach.flavor.source: Iron given a will by a mage's binding, and it does not tire.

cards.iliacSet.ironAtronach.rules.source: Ongoing: your atronach units have +1 power.

cards.iliacSet.kingGothryd.flavor.source: Daggerfall's young king, and every knight in it is his.

cards.iliacSet.kingGothryd.rules.source: Ongoing: your knight units have +1 power.

cards.iliacSet.knightOfTheDragon.flavor.source: Daggerfall's order rides together or not at all.

cards.iliacSet.knightOfTheDragon.rules.source: Ongoing: your knight units here have +1 power.

cards.iliacSet.knightOfTheFlame.flavor.source: They ride at the biggest thing on the field.

cards.iliacSet.knightOfTheFlame.rules.source: Reveal: the strongest enemy unit here loses 2 power.

cards.iliacSet.knightOfTheRose.flavor.source: Wayrest's knights carry letters as well as lances.

cards.iliacSet.knightOfTheWheel.flavor.source: The Order of the Wheel turns, and its knights grow with every turning.

cards.iliacSet.knightOfTheWheel.rules.source: End of turn: this gains +1 power.

cards.iliacSet.lamia.flavor.source: She sings the bravest down first.

cards.iliacSet.lamia.rules.source: Reveal: the strongest enemy unit here loses 2 power.

cards.iliacSet.lich.flavor.source: It traded its death for a library.

cards.iliacSet.lich.rules.source: Ongoing: your undead units here have +1 power.

cards.iliacSet.magesGuildApprentice.flav.source: Her first spark, and she aimed it well.

cards.iliacSet.magesGuildApprentice.rule.source: Reveal: the weakest enemy unit here loses 1 power.

cards.iliacSet.magesGuildArchmage.flavor.source: Every book in the hall, and the ones not on the shelves.

cards.iliacSet.magesGuildBattlemage.flav.source: The guild teaches lightning to the dues-paid.

cards.iliacSet.magesGuildBattlemage.rule.source: Reveal: enemy units here lose 1 power.

cards.iliacSet.magesGuildHall.flavor.source: Members pay less for the lesson.

cards.iliacSet.malacath.flavor.source: The god of curses remembers every orc by name.

cards.iliacSet.malacath.rules.source: Ongoing: your orc units have +2 power.

cards.iliacSet.mehrunesDagon.flavor.source: The Prince of Destruction asks nothing. He takes.

cards.iliacSet.mehrunesRazor.flavor.source: One cut, and the greatest falls.

cards.iliacSet.mehrunesRazor.rules.source: Destroy the strongest enemy unit here.

cards.iliacSet.meridia.flavor.source: Her light finds the dead wherever they hide.

cards.iliacSet.meridia.rules.source: Ongoing: enemy undead units have -2 power.

cards.iliacSet.molagBal.flavor.source: The Lord of Domination asks no bargain. He takes the bound and keeps them.

cards.iliacSet.molagBal.rules.source: Ongoing: your undead units have +2 power.

cards.iliacSet.mummy.flavor.source: Wrapped for the long dark, and patient in it.

cards.iliacSet.mummy.rules.source: End of turn: your weakest undead unit here gains +1 power.

cards.iliacSet.namira.flavor.source: The Spurned pull down the proud.

cards.iliacSet.namira.rules.source: Ongoing: enemy units that cost 4 or more have -2 power.

cards.iliacSet.nightblade.flavor.source: A blade you only see in the morning.

cards.iliacSet.nightblade.rules.source: End of turn: the weakest enemy unit here loses 1 power.

cards.iliacSet.nocturnal.flavor.source: The Night Mistress keeps her own in shadow.

cards.iliacSet.nocturnal.rules.source: Reveal: draw a card. Ongoing: your thief units have +2 power.

cards.iliacSet.nymph.flavor.source: She tells you a secret, and you forget your sword.

cards.iliacSet.oghmaInfinium.flavor.source: Hermaeus Mora lends it. He never forgets the loan.

cards.iliacSet.orc.flavor.source: Never the only one in the pass.

cards.iliacSet.orc.rules.source: Ongoing: your orc units here have +1 power.

cards.iliacSet.orcSergeant.flavor.source: It shouts, and the line stands.

cards.iliacSet.orcSergeant.rules.source: Reveal: your orc units here gain +1 power.

cards.iliacSet.orcShaman.flavor.source: Malacath's curses carry well in cold air.

cards.iliacSet.orcShaman.rules.source: Reveal: the weakest enemy unit here loses 2 power.

cards.iliacSet.orcWarlord.flavor.source: Gortwog dreams of a city. This one dreams of a war.

cards.iliacSet.orcWarlord.rules.source: Ongoing: your orc units have +1 power.

cards.iliacSet.orsinium.flavor.source: Gortwog's city, built again in the mountains.

cards.iliacSet.priestOfAkatosh.rules.source: End of turn: your weakest unit here gains +1 power.

cards.iliacSet.priestOfArkay.flavor.source: Arkay keeps the cycle. The dead go back.

cards.iliacSet.priestOfArkay.rules.source: Reveal: destroy the weakest enemy undead unit here.

cards.iliacSet.priestOfDibella.flavor.source: Beauty opens doors a key will not.

cards.iliacSet.priestOfJulianos.flavor.source: Logic, applied, is a kind of magicka.

cards.iliacSet.priestOfKynareth.flavor.source: The wind carries the faithful where they are needed.

cards.iliacSet.priestOfKynareth.rules.source: Reveal: move your weakest unit here to the next holding round the table with room.

cards.iliacSet.priestOfMara.flavor.source: While she prays, no one here stands alone.

cards.iliacSet.priestOfMara.rules.source: Ongoing: your units here have +1 power.

cards.iliacSet.priestOfStendarr.flavor.source: Mercy, laid on with both hands.

cards.iliacSet.priestOfStendarr.rules.source: Reveal: your units here gain +1 power.

cards.iliacSet.priestOfZenithar.flavor.source: Work honestly, and the god of trade pays honestly.

cards.iliacSet.privateersHold.flavor.source: In the dark, nobody knows who holds the cave.

cards.iliacSet.privateersHold.rules.source: Cards here are played face down and unveiled when the game ends. Spells cannot be played here.

cards.iliacSet.ranger.flavor.source: The wilds have one law, and the ranger keeps it.

cards.iliacSet.ranger.rules.source: Reveal: the strongest enemy beast unit here loses 2 power.

cards.iliacSet.rat.flavor.source: Where there is one, the cellar has a hundred.

cards.iliacSet.recall.flavor.source: Here a moment ago. Needed elsewhere.

cards.iliacSet.recall.rules.source: Move your strongest unit here to the next holding round the table with room.

cards.iliacSet.sabretoothTiger.flavor.source: It goes for the biggest throat in the hall.

cards.iliacSet.sabretoothTiger.rules.source: Reveal: the strongest enemy unit here loses 1 power.

cards.iliacSet.sanguine.flavor.source: Every tavern is his temple, and the small folk drink free.

cards.iliacSet.sanguine.rules.source: Ongoing: your units that cost 1 or 2 have +1 power.

cards.iliacSet.sanguineRose.flavor.source: Each thorn a door, and something comes through.

cards.iliacSet.sentinel.flavor.source: Under the Alik'r sun, even the small burn bright.

cards.iliacSet.sentinel.rules.source: Units here that cost 1 or 2 have +1 power.

cards.iliacSet.sethrakul.flavor.source: The Old Coil rises where the packet lanes run deep.

cards.iliacSet.sethrakul.rules.source: End of turn: enemy units here lose 1 power.

cards.iliacSet.shock.flavor.source: It jumps from man to man.

cards.iliacSet.shornhelm.flavor.source: The Wrothgarian wind takes the weakest first.

cards.iliacSet.shornhelm.rules.source: End of turn: the weakest unit on each side here loses 1 power.

cards.iliacSet.skeletalWarrior.flavor.source: They rise in ranks, as they fell.

cards.iliacSet.skeletalWarrior.rules.source: Ongoing: your undead units here have +1 power.

cards.iliacSet.slaughterfish.flavor.source: Out of the water, it has one good bite in it.

cards.iliacSet.slaughterfish.rules.source: End of turn: this loses 1 power.

cards.iliacSet.spectreOfLysandus.flavor.source: Vengeance! The dead king walks Daggerfall's streets each night.

cards.iliacSet.spider.flavor.source: The small walk into its web; the large walk through it.

cards.iliacSet.spider.rules.source: Ongoing: enemy units here that cost 1 or 2 have -1 power.

cards.iliacSet.spriggan.flavor.source: The wood mends what stands beside it.

cards.iliacSet.spriggan.rules.source: Reveal: your units here gain +1 power.

cards.iliacSet.talesAndTallows.flavor.source: Even the lighthearted keep off the dark streets. The dead do walk tonight.

cards.iliacSet.thaumaturge.flavor.source: Where she stands, every mage stands taller.

cards.iliacSet.thaumaturge.rules.source: Ongoing: your mage units here have +1 power.

cards.iliacSet.thievesGuildFilcher.flavo.source: Your purse was lighter than you thought.

cards.iliacSet.turnUndead.flavor.source: Back into the earth, by Arkay's leave.

cards.iliacSet.turnUndead.rules.source: Destroy the weakest enemy undead unit here.

cards.iliacSet.valkynazRuhn.flavor.source: Warden of the Burning Gate. He was set to hold it, and he holds it.

cards.iliacSet.valkynazRuhn.rules.source: Reveal: destroy the weakest enemy unit here.

cards.iliacSet.vampire.flavor.source: It has all night, and every night after.

cards.iliacSet.vampire.rules.source: End of turn: this gains +1 power.

cards.iliacSet.vampireCrypt.flavor.source: The dead are at home here. You are not.

cards.iliacSet.wabbajack.flavor.source: Sheogorath thinks this is very funny.

cards.iliacSet.wabbajack.rules.source: Turn the strongest enemy unit here into a Rat.

cards.iliacSet.warlock.flavor.source: He walks out of town on the 13th of Frostfall, and comes back owing someone.

cards.iliacSet.wayrest.flavor.source: Its walls let in only so many.

cards.iliacSet.wayrest.rules.source: Each side holds only 3 cards here.

cards.iliacSet.wereboar.flavor.source: Hircine's other children run with it.

cards.iliacSet.wereboar.rules.source: Reveal: your beast units here gain +1 power.

cards.iliacSet.werewolf.flavor.source: Every night a little less of the man.

cards.iliacSet.werewolf.rules.source: End of turn: this gains +1 power.

cards.iliacSet.wraith.flavor.source: While it lingers, no fire burns warm.

cards.iliacSet.wraith.rules.source: Ongoing: enemy units here have -1 power.

cards.iliacSet.zombie.flavor.source: Strong, for now. It is coming apart.

cards.iliacSet.zombie.rules.source: End of turn: this loses 1 power.

cards.kingsGambit.cell.pillar.source: A pillar: no piece walks through it, and it blocks a ranged shot.

cards.kingsGambit.cell.wall.source: A wall: no piece walks through it, and it blocks a ranged shot.

cards.kingsGambit.cell.water.source: Water: it cannot be crossed on foot, but ranged attacks pass over it.

cards.kingsGambit.guide.army.body.source: Up to {units, plural, one {# unit} other {# units}} for {points, plural, one {# point} other {# points}}. Stronger units cost more, and ranged units cost {pct}% extra. Your king joins for free.

cards.kingsGambit.guide.ground.body.source: Walls and pillars block movement and shots. Water blocks movement, but shots pass over it. Every {every, plural, one {round} other {# rounds}}, warning cells turn into fire ({fire}), spikes ({spikes}) or poison ({poison}). A piece that ends its turn on one loses that much health.

cards.kingsGambit.guide.online.body.source: Sit at the board, build your army and press Ready. The game starts when both players are ready. Each turn lasts {s} seconds. If your clock runs out {idle, plural, one {# turn} other {# turns}} in a row, you lose.

cards.kingsGambit.guide.onlineFun.body.source: No gold changes hands at this table. A game between two registered accounts counts on the season board.

cards.kingsGambit.guide.onlineGold.body.source: At the gold table both players stake the same amount: {stakes} gold. The winner takes the pot, both stakes. If you lose, forfeit, leave mid-game or let the clock run out, the other player takes it.

cards.kingsGambit.guide.regular.body.source: Each regular plays at a rank. A higher rank means a bigger army, more potions, fewer blunders and a higher minimum stake.

cards.kingsGambit.guide.stake.body.source: Stake {a}, {b} or {c} times the regular's minimum stake. If you win, you get back {pay} times your stake. If you lose, forfeit or stand up mid-game, the regular keeps it.

cards.kingsGambit.guide.strike.body.source: A melee piece strikes the cell next to it. A ranged piece shoots up to {range, plural, one {# cell} other {# cells}} when nothing is in the way. A hit does {low}% to {high}% of the attacker's attack.

cards.kingsGambit.guide.turn.body.source: {actions, plural, one {# action} other {# actions}} a turn: move a piece up to {move, plural, one {# cell} other {# cells}}, strike, or give one of your pieces a potion that heals {heal} health. You have {potions, plural, one {# potion} other {# potions}} a game.

cards.kingsGambit.guide.win.body.source: Defeat the other king, or every piece on the other side.

cards.kingsGambit.info.ranged.source: Level {level} - Attack {attack} - Ranged: shoots up to {range, plural, one {# cell} other {# cells}}

cards.kingsGambit.tier.grandmaster.blurb.source: Legendary across Tamriel. Bring your best army.

cards.kingsGambit.tier.seasoned.blurb.source: Plays most nights, and knows the game.

cards.kingsGambit.tier.veteran.blurb.source: A shrewd tactician who rarely makes a mistake.

cards.kingsGambit.what.source: The King's Gambit is a game of armies and kings, played on a board of {cols} by {rows, plural, one {# cell} other {# cells}}. Each side protects its king. Defeat the other king to win.

cards.kingsGambit.words.action.meaning.source: Each turn gives you actions: a move, a strike or a potion is one.

cards.kingsGambit.words.army.meaning.source: The units you take into the game.

cards.kingsGambit.words.autofill.meaning.source: Fills the rest of your army for you.

cards.kingsGambit.words.blunder.meaning.source: A careless move a regular makes now and then. Lower-ranked regulars blunder more often.

cards.kingsGambit.words.clock.meaning.source: Each turn lasts {s} seconds. If it runs out {idle, plural, one {# turn} other {# turns}} in a row, you lose.

cards.kingsGambit.words.crown.meaning.source: The kingdom whose King leads your army.

cards.kingsGambit.words.fallen.meaning.source: The pieces a side has lost.

cards.kingsGambit.words.forFun.meaning.source: A game with no gold at stake: any game against a regular online or one who has paid out all they will tonight, and any game at a no-gold table.

cards.kingsGambit.words.forfeit.meaning.source: You give up the game and lose your stake.

cards.kingsGambit.words.grandmaster.mean.source: The title held by the season board's top player. It is separate from the regulars' Grandmaster rank.

cards.kingsGambit.words.ground.meaning.source: Cells no piece can walk on. Walls and pillars also block shots. Water does not.

cards.kingsGambit.words.hazard.meaning.source: Hazards on the board. A piece that ends its turn on one is hurt.

cards.kingsGambit.words.health.meaning.source: How much damage a piece can take before it falls.

cards.kingsGambit.words.king.meaning.source: Your most important piece. If your king falls, you lose.

cards.kingsGambit.words.layout.meaning.source: The shape of the board, chosen at random each game.

cards.kingsGambit.words.leastStake.meani.source: The smallest stake a regular will play for.

cards.kingsGambit.words.level.meaning.source: How experienced a unit is. Higher levels hit harder.

cards.kingsGambit.words.melee.meaning.source: Strikes only the cell next to it.

cards.kingsGambit.words.move.meaning.source: A piece walks a few cells, around walls, pillars and water.

cards.kingsGambit.words.points.meaning.source: What you build your army with. Never gold.

cards.kingsGambit.words.pot.meaning.source: Both stakes, held by the table. The winner takes all of it.

cards.kingsGambit.words.potion.meaning.source: Heals one of your pieces. Each side has a few a game.

cards.kingsGambit.words.range.meaning.source: The cells a piece can strike, and a foe it can strike now.

cards.kingsGambit.words.ranged.meaning.source: Shoots from a distance when nothing is in the way.

cards.kingsGambit.words.rated.meaning.source: A game between two registered accounts. It moves both players' ratings.

cards.kingsGambit.words.reach.meaning.source: The cells a piece can move to now.

cards.kingsGambit.words.ready.meaning.source: Your army is built and, at the gold table, your stake is placed. The game starts when both players are ready.

cards.kingsGambit.words.regular.meaning.source: A tavern local at this table who plays against you.

cards.kingsGambit.words.round.meaning.source: Your turn and the other side's together.

cards.kingsGambit.words.season.meaning.source: The season's ranking of rated games.

cards.kingsGambit.words.stake.meaning.source: The gold you bet. The table holds it until the game ends.

cards.kingsGambit.words.tier.meaning.source: How strong a regular plays: Amateur, Seasoned, Veteran or Grandmaster.

cards.kingsGambit.words.warning.meaning.source: A cell where a hazard is coming. It hurts nobody yet.
