prof.craft.xpLimit.source: (+{xp} {profession} experience. {crafts} are past Journeyman, so the crafter's limit holds {profession} at rank {rank})

prof.craftWrit.countPotion.source: {n, plural, one {a Potion of {name}} other {# Potions of {name}}}

prof.craftWrit.filled.source: The {guild} thanks you: {pay, number} silver, {xp, number} {track} experience and {renown, number} Renown.

prof.craftWrit.heldPiece.source: {made, number} of your own in your pack

prof.craftWrit.heldPotion.source: {made, number} brewed by you, {pack, number} in your pack

prof.craftWrit.madeDish.source: Of your own cooking, never sold - the servings leave your pack.

prof.craftWrit.madeKit.source: Of your own make, never sold - the kits leave your pack.

prof.craftWrit.madePotion.source: Of your own brewing - the bottles leave your pack.

prof.craftWrit.pay.source: Pays {pay, number} silver, {xp, number} {track} experience, {renown, number} Renown and standing with the {guild}

prof.craftWrit.shortBrew.source: Brew {n, number} more yourself at an alchemy station - found or bought bottles do not count

prof.craftWrit.shortCarry.source: Carry {n, number} more of these bottles in your pack

prof.craftWrit.shortMake.source: Make {n, number} more yourself - pieces you bought or sold do not count

prof.hall.firsts.closed.source: First-time bonuses: {spent, number} of {all, number} made. This craft can rise no further, so they pay nothing.

prof.hall.firsts.line.source: First-time bonuses: {spent, number} of {all, number} made (+{share, number} XP each)

prof.hall.src.anvil.source: A piece at the anvil or jeweler's bench

prof.hall.src.atGradeClean.source: {xp, number} XP at grade {tier}, {more, number} for clean work

prof.hall.src.courtOre.source: Court writ for ore or stone

prof.hall.src.disenchantXp.source: {per, number} XP per Essence per grade ({xp, number} at grade {tier})

prof.hall.src.dishXp.source: {xp, number} XP, {more, number} with every pan on time

prof.hall.src.firstBuild.source: Your first piece at each grade, first cut and first mix

prof.hall.src.firstCloth.source: Your first piece at each grade (not of cloth bought with silver)

prof.hall.src.firstDish.source: Your first of each dish and potion

prof.hall.src.firstPiece.source: Your first piece at each grade

prof.hall.src.gradeNote.source: Each grade is worth {per, number} experience. Work more than two grades below your best (grade {top}) earns a quarter.

prof.hall.src.gradeNoteSmith.source: Each grade is worth {per, number} experience a piece and {ingot, number} an ingot. Work more than two grades below your best (grade {top}) earns a quarter.

prof.hall.src.mason.source: A cut or mix at the mason's bench

prof.hall.src.masonXp.source: {xp, number} XP each, {more, number} for clean work

prof.hall.src.potionWrit.source: Guild writ for potions or dishes

prof.hall.src.starsPct.source: +{pct}%, not on writs or first-time bonuses

prof.maker.away.source: A potion mixed here earns no {profession} experience. At an alchemy station (an Alchemist's, a Mages Guild hall or your own home) the potion maker brews it from your Stores and what you carry, and it does.

prof.maker.fee.source: Mixed as the classic potion maker mixes, it earns no {profession} experience: brewing it here costs {fee} gold.

prof.maker.rank.source: Mixed as the classic potion maker mixes, it earns no {profession} experience: {potion} is brewed from {profession} rank {rank}.

prof.maker.storedRank.source: {potion} is brewed from {profession} rank {rank}. Take your Stores' ingredients out of the cauldron to mix it from what you carry.

prof.master.about.source: A Legendary piece with three lines you choose. Their values roll in the Legendary band. It carries no Legendary power.

prof.master.madeToday.source: Today's Master's work is made. The next can be made after midnight UTC.

prof.master.takes.source: It takes these goods, the station's fee and these catalysts:

prof.page.alchemy.away.source: Alchemy is brewed at an alchemy station: an Alchemist's or a Mages Guild hall ({fee} gold a brew), or your own home's. Your potions go to your pack.

prof.page.alchemy.brewAt.source: {n, plural, one {A potion} other {# potions}} a brew. {potent}{withSteps, select, yes { (the Apothecary's +{apothecary}% with it)} other {}}. +{unbruised}% for each herb picked unbruised.

prof.page.alchemy.counterOne.source: A potion made only from the Apothecaries' goods brews just one.

prof.page.alchemy.made.source: {n, plural, one {A potion} other {# potions}} a brew.

prof.page.alchemy.neverPotent.source: Never Potent (a cure acts at once)

prof.page.alchemy.potentLine.source: {potent}{gathered, select, yes { - and +{unbruised}% for each of its herbs you picked unbruised} other {}}.

prof.page.alchemy.shop.source: The alchemist's station - {fee} gold a brew.

prof.page.alchemy.sources.source: Herbs come from Herbalism, metals and gems from veins, the Pearl from the sea and body parts from Hunting. Buy the rest at the Apothecaries' counter. Your potions go to your pack.

prof.page.alchemy.transmuter.source: A Transmuter (an Alchemy choice at 100) turns two of a metal and a Mercury into one of the next metal up: Tin, Copper, Silver, Gold, Platinum.

prof.page.alchemy.xpFirst.source: {xp} {profession} experience, and {more, number} the first time.

prof.page.alchemy.xpMade.source: {xp} {profession} experience. You have brewed this before, so no first-time bonus.

prof.page.alchemy.xpOwed.source: {xp} {profession} experience, plus a {more, number} first-time bonus.

prof.page.alchemy.xpShop.source: {xp} {profession} experience. It is made only from the Apothecaries' goods, so it earns no first-time bonus.

prof.page.anvil.away.source: Smithing is done at an anvil, beside a forge: a Weaponsmith's or an Armorer's ({fee} gold a craft), or your own home's forge.

prof.page.anvil.down.source: You let the ingot cool; nothing is spent.

prof.page.anvil.heat.source: The heat: strike while the glow is in the band (Space)

prof.page.anvil.odds.source: Quality chances: {odds}. They get better the further your rank ({rank}) is above the recipe's ({need}). Land every strike while the glow is in the band to raise the result one quality.

prof.page.anvil.shop.source: The smith's anvil - {fee} gold a craft.

prof.page.bench.arrows.source: Makes a quiver of 20 arrows. Arrows have no quality.

prof.page.bench.away.source: Carpentry is done at a workbench: a Furniture Store's or a joinery's ({fee} gold a craft or a saw), or your own home's.

prof.page.bench.down.source: You set the plane down; nothing is spent.

prof.page.bench.furniture.source: Furniture goes to your things. Place it in a room of your own with Decorate.

prof.page.bench.noLogs.source: A log saws into two planks here. Logs come from Logging.

prof.page.bench.odds.source: Quality chances: {odds}. They get better the further your rank ({rank}) is above the recipe's ({need}). Draw the plane true to the grain to raise the result one quality.

prof.page.bench.ramKit.source: A Ram Kit goes to your Stores. Deliver it to your guild's Siege Camp with a seat writ. If the camp wins a Right of Siege, it goes to the battle against a Gatehouse.

prof.page.bench.shop.source: The {who, select, carpenter {carpenter} other {furnisher}}'s workbench - {fee} gold a craft or a saw.

prof.page.buy.source: Buy {n} from {who, select, smith {the smith} furnisher {the furnisher} weavers {the Weavers} other {the Apothecaries}} - {cost} silver

prof.page.chisel.how.source: The chisel ({what}): strike the marked line {n, plural, one {once} other {# times}}. Press the line, or set the chisel with the arrows and strike with Space

prof.page.cold.forge.source: The forge is cold. Smelting is done online, from your Crafting page.

prof.page.cold.jeweller.source: The jeweler's bench is bare. Jewelcrafting is done online, from your Crafting page.

prof.page.cold.loom.source: The loom is still. Outfitting is done online, from your Crafting page.

prof.page.cold.mason.source: The mason's bench is idle. Masonry is done online, from your Crafting page.

prof.page.cold.workbench.source: The workbench is bare. Carpentry is done online, from your Crafting page.

prof.page.craft.xpFirst.source: {xp} {profession} experience, and {more, number} more the first time you make this piece at this grade.

prof.page.craft.xpLimit.source: {room, plural, =0 {No {profession} experience} other {At most # {profession} experience}}: {crafts} are past Journeyman, so the crafter's limit holds {profession} at rank {rank}.

prof.page.craft.xpMade.source: {xp} {profession} experience. You have made this before, so no first-time bonus.

prof.page.craft.xpOwed.source: {xp} {profession} experience, plus a {more, number} first-time bonus.

prof.page.craft.xpTop.source: {room, plural, =0 {No {profession} experience: {profession} is at Master} other {At most # {profession} experience: {profession} stops at Master}}.

prof.page.crafting.away.source: Stand at a station to craft. Press {key} there to open this page on it.

prof.page.crafting.awayKeyless.source: Stand at a station to craft. Your Professions key opens this page on it.

prof.page.enchant.away.source: Disenchanting is done at an enchanting station: a Mages Guild hall ({fee} gold a piece), or your own home's. A crafted piece comes apart into Arcane Essence in your Stores.

prof.page.enchant.full.source: Your Stores have room for {n} more Arcane Essence, not enough for this piece.

prof.page.enchant.gives.source: {points, number} points: {essence} Arcane Essence, +{xp} Enchanting experience

prof.page.enchant.givesTwo.source: {points, number} points: {essence} Arcane Essence, +{xp} Enchanting experience (two for a Disenchanter)

prof.page.enchant.none.source: No crafted piece in your pack has enough enchantment to give Essence. Only pieces a player crafted online can be taken apart.

prof.page.enchant.pctAt.source: The item maker costs you {pct}% less.

prof.page.enchant.shop.source: The guild's enchanter - {fee} gold a piece.

prof.page.enchant.under.source: {points, number} points. One Arcane Essence needs {per, number}.

prof.page.fire.away.source: Cook at a fire, such as a campfire, a hearth or a brazier. Stand close to its flame. Your dishes go to your pack.

prof.page.fire.down.source: You take the pan off the fire; nothing is spent.

prof.page.fire.first.source: The first time you cook this dish: {more, number} more {profession} experience.

prof.page.fire.firstMade.source: You have cooked this before, so no first-time bonus.

prof.page.fire.firstOwed.source: First time cooking this: {more, number} more {profession} experience.

prof.page.fire.how.source: The pan ({dish}): take each pan off when it is done, inside the window (Space). {n, plural, one {# pan} other {# pans}}

prof.page.fire.noSkillet.source: A Skillet in your pack would widen the pan's window.

prof.page.fire.pans.source: {pans, plural, one {# pan} other {# pans}}. Take every pan off in time for {steps, plural, =0 {half as much again as its {xp} {profession} experience} one {{clean} {profession} experience instead of {xp}, with the town Apothecary's step in both} other {{clean} {profession} experience instead of {xp}, with the town Apothecary's # steps in both}}.

prof.page.fire.servesTwo.source: Two servings (a Cook's), into your pack.

prof.page.fire.skillet.source: Your Skillet widens the pan's window.

prof.page.fire.sources.source: Raw Meat comes from skinning, Raw Fish from the net, the Mushroom, the Egg, the Apple and the Orange from the Basket, and herbs from their patches. All go into your Materials Bag, then your pack. A Raw Fish from your pack or bag cooked over the flame is a plain meal and gives no Cooking experience.

prof.page.firsts.higher.source: All made at your rank. {n, number} more at higher ranks.

prof.page.firsts.owed.source: Still to earn at your rank: {n, number}.

prof.page.forge.away.source: Smelting is done at a forge: a Weaponsmith's or an Armorer's ({fee} gold a smelt), or your own home's forge.

prof.page.forge.charcoal.source: Steel needs Charcoal. Burn a log here to make it, or buy it from the smith.

prof.page.forge.shop.source: The smith's forge - {fee} gold a smelt.

prof.page.gentle.source: Gentle work: crafting and gathering need no timing, with no bruises, no glints to find and no bonus for clean work

prof.page.hands.source: Your hands are at {at, select, anvil {the anvil} workbench {the workbench} loom {the loom} mason {the mason's bench} fire {the fire} other {the jeweler's bench}}. Finish there first.

prof.page.heartwood.source: Use a Heartwood for a plank one grade better ({n} stored)

prof.page.how.alchemy.source: Brew on the Crafting page at an alchemy station: Alchemists, Mages Guild halls and your home have one. It brews the classic potion maker's 20 recipes from what you carry or store. Elsewhere, a potion maker earns no Provisioning experience.

prof.page.how.building.source: Carpentry needs a workbench: Furniture Stores, joineries and your home have one. It saws logs into planks and makes staves, bows, arrows and furniture. A mason's bench, in General Stores and your home, cuts stone and mixes Mortar.

prof.page.how.cooking.source: Cook at any lit fire: a campfire, a hearth or a brazier. Stand close to the flame. Dishes use the meat you skin, the fish you net, herbs and Basket finds, and go to your pack.

prof.page.how.enchanting.source: Enchanting rises as you break crafted pieces into Arcane Essence at an enchanting station, on the Crafting page. Mages Guild halls and your home have one. {off, select, yes {The item maker costs you {pct}% less.} other {From Journeyman on, the item maker costs you less.}}

prof.page.how.fishing.source: With a Fishing-Net in your pack, fish while standing or swimming in water, or aboard a ship, at any hour. Hold the use key to draw back and release to cast. When the floats dip, press it again. Then hold to raise the band and release to lower it, keeping the net's weight inside the band to fill the net. Cast at a rising school for an extra fish.

prof.page.how.herbalism.source: Press the use key at a patch of herbs in the wilderness. Common herbs need no tool; the rest need a Sickle in your pack. With a Basket, the patch's list also lets you search it for food. The Sickle and the Basket can be used from your hotbar or quick slots as well. Used from your pack, a tool only tells you where it can be used.

prof.page.how.hunting.source: With a Skinning Knife in your pack, you can skin a creature you killed. Hold the use key at the start of the line and drag the knife along it. Used from your hotbar or a quick slot, the knife is held for you: follow the line with your eyes. The carcass's list also lets you search it.

prof.page.how.logging.source: Press the use key at a tree in the wilderness. You need a Wood-Axe in your pack. Only some trees in each place can be felled each day. The axe can also be used from your hotbar or quick slots. Used from your pack, a tool only tells you where it can be used.

prof.page.how.mining.source: Press the use key at a vein of ore or a boulder in the wilderness, or at a vein in a dungeon. You need a Pick-Axe in your pack. The pick can also be used from your hotbar or quick slots. Used from your pack, a tool only tells you where it can be used.

prof.page.how.miningSurveyor.source: As a {name}, you need no witnesses: your veins can give any ore the land holds. A region's own ore still needs the other players.

prof.page.how.smithing.source: Smith at a forge: Weaponsmiths, Armorers and your home have one. It smelts ore into ingots; its anvil makes weapons, armor and tools, even from raw ore. Jewelry needs a jeweler's bench, in Pawn Shops, Gem Stores and your home.

prof.page.jewel.away.source: Jewelcrafting is done at a jeweler's bench: a Pawn Shop's or a Gem Store's ({fee} gold a piece), or your own home's.

prof.page.jewel.cracked.source: Set a Siege-cracked Gem as the {gem} ({n} stored)

prof.page.jewel.down.source: You set the stone down; nothing is spent.

prof.page.jewel.how.source: The facet ({name}) - stop the turn where the stone catches the light (Space): {n, plural, one {# facet} other {# facets}}

prof.page.jewel.odds.source: Quality chances: {odds}. They get better the further your rank ({rank}) is above the recipe's ({need}). Stop every turn where the stone catches the light to raise the result one quality.{steps, plural, =0 {} one { The town's Apothecary raises it one more.} other { The town's Apothecary raises it # more.}}

prof.page.jewel.pointsNote.source: {points}{hand, select, goldsmith { - a Goldsmith's Silver, counted as Gold} gemcutter { - a Gemcutter's gem} other {}}. The item maker spends them{wand, select, yes {} other {, beside a Masterwork's own enchantment}}.

prof.page.jewel.shop.source: The jeweler's bench - {fee} gold a piece.

prof.page.jewel.sources.source: Silver, Gold and Platinum come from veins (Mining), gems from a clean strike on a vein's glint, the Pearl from nets at sea and Linen from the Weavers. Your pieces go to your pack.

prof.page.later.twoColour.source: Comes when cloth can take a second dye

prof.page.later.wagon.source: Comes when wagons can be upgraded

prof.page.limit.rule.source: Only {max} crafts can rise past Journeyman{full, select, yes {. Yours are {crafts}, so your other crafts stop at rank {rank}} other {. Once {max} of yours pass rank {rank}, the others stop there}}. A craft never loses rank.

prof.page.loom.away.source: Outfitting, and the tanning of hides, is done at a loom: a Clothing Store's ({fee} gold a craft, a cure or a weave), or your own home's.

prof.page.loom.down.source: You set the needle down; nothing is spent.

prof.page.loom.furnishings.source: Furnishings go to your things. Place them in a room of your own with Decorate.

prof.page.loom.how.source: The stitch: press on the beat, {n} in a row (Space)

prof.page.loom.noHides.source: Two hides cure into one leather here (one hide for a Tanner). Hides come from skinning bodies you kill (Hunting).

prof.page.loom.odds.source: Quality chances: {odds}. They get better the further your rank ({rank}) is above the recipe's ({need}). Press every stitch on the beat to raise the result one quality.

prof.page.loom.oddsLeather.source: Quality chances: {odds}. They get better the further your rank ({rank}) is above the recipe's ({need}). Press every stitch on the beat to raise the result one quality. Being a Leatherworker raises leather one more.

prof.page.loom.oddsTailor.source: Quality chances: {odds}. They get better the further your rank ({rank}) is above the recipe's ({need}). Press every stitch on the beat to raise the result one quality. Being a Tailor raises clothing one more.

prof.page.loom.shop.source: The tailor's loom and tanning rack - {fee} gold a craft, a cure or a weave.

prof.page.loom.silk.source: {name} comes only from the sieges, as a Siege Honor's Spoils.

prof.page.mason.away.source: Masonry is done at a mason's bench: a General Store's ({fee} gold a cut, a mix or a carving), or your own home's.

prof.page.mason.decor.source: Stone decor, carved for a room of your own:

prof.page.mason.decorGoes.source: Stone decor goes to your things. Place it in a room of your own with Decorate.

prof.page.mason.decorSculptor.source: Stone decor, such as columns, benches, fonts and statue plinths, is carved by a Sculptor (a Masonry choice at 100).

prof.page.mason.down.source: You set the chisel down; nothing is spent.

prof.page.mason.noStone.source: Rough Stone is quarried from the boulders of the rock fields with a Pick-Axe (Mining).

prof.page.mason.odds.source: Quality chances: {odds}. They get better the further your rank ({rank}) is above the recipe's ({need}). Hit the marked line with every strike to raise the result one quality.

prof.page.mason.shop.source: The mason's bench - {fee} gold a cut, a mix or a carving.

prof.page.mason.works.source: Two Rough Stone are cut into one Cut Stone (two for a Quarryman). Sulphur, Lead and five Rough Stone mix into ten Mortar. Hit the marked line with every strike for half again as much Building experience.

prof.page.mason.worksFirst.source: Your first cut and your first mix each earn {more, number} more {profession} experience.

prof.page.mason.worksOwed.source: First-time bonus, {more, number} {profession} experience each: first cut {cut, select, owed {still to earn} other {made}}, first mix {mix, select, owed {still to earn} other {made}}.

prof.page.notPractised.source: This profession is not practiced yet.

prof.page.plane.clean.source: A clean pass, true to the grain.

prof.page.plane.how.source: The plane: press at the top of the board and draw along the grain to the bottom

prof.page.plane.quick.source: Too quick. Draw the plane slowly.

prof.page.plane.slips.source: {n, plural, one {let go # time - start again at the head} other {let go # times - start again at the head}}

prof.page.plane.strayed.source: The plane strayed from the grain.

prof.page.purse.alchemy.source: The alchemist asks {fee} gold a brew; you carry {have}.

prof.page.purse.anvil.source: The smith asks {fee} gold a craft; you carry {have}.

prof.page.purse.enchanter.source: The enchanter asks {fee} gold a piece; you carry {have}.

prof.page.purse.forge.source: The smith asks {fee} gold a smelt; you carry {have}.

prof.page.purse.jeweller.source: The jeweler asks {fee} gold a piece; you carry {have}.

prof.page.purse.loom.source: The tailor asks {fee} gold a craft, a cure or a weave; you carry {have}.

prof.page.purse.mason.source: The mason asks {fee} gold a cut, a mix or a carving; you carry {have}.

prof.page.purse.temperAnvil.source: The smith asks {fee} gold a temper; you carry {have}.

prof.page.purse.temperLoom.source: The tailor asks {fee} gold a temper; you carry {have}.

prof.page.purse.workbench.source: The {who, select, carpenter {carpenter} other {furnisher}} asks {fee} gold a craft or a saw; you carry {have}.

prof.page.show.noneCan.source: Nothing here can be made from what you hold.

prof.page.show.noneFirst.source: No first-time bonus is left here at your rank.

prof.page.specs.respecFreeArmed.source: Press again: free, in effect at once

prof.page.specs.respecNowArmed.source: Press again: {cost, number} silver, in effect at once. The next change waits {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}

prof.page.stores.empty.source: Your Stores are empty. What you gather online goes here. Press the use key at an herb patch, a tree, an ore vein, a boulder or a creature you killed, or in water with a net. You can also use the matching tool from your hotbar or a quick slot. Tools used from your pack gather nothing.

prof.page.stores.emptyCarry.source: Your Stores are empty. What you gather goes into your Materials Bag or pack. Put it in here in any town.

prof.page.stores.essenceStays.source: Arcane Essence stays in your Stores and can't go to your pack. Sell it on the Market tab.

prof.page.stores.goldGoods.source: Bought with gold. It can go to your pack or be sold on the market for gold, but no station, craft, writ or silver sale takes it.

prof.page.stores.goldStays.source: Bought with gold, or made from a piece bought with gold. It can be sold on the market for gold, but no station, craft, writ or silver sale takes it.

prof.page.stores.looseGoods.source: From your pack. Stations can use it, or it can go back to your pack. Writs, guilds and sales only take what you gathered or took from your Stores.

prof.page.stores.looseMade.source: Made from goods from your pack. Stations can use it, but writs, guilds and sales only take what you gathered or took from your Stores.

prof.page.stores.siegeStays.source: Siege works stay in your Stores. Deliver them to your guild's Siege Camp with a writ on a Notice Board's Work tab.

prof.page.stores.stockStays.source: It stays at the bench for the anvil and the workbench to use.

prof.page.stores.withdrawBusy.source: The Stores are still counting your last withdrawal.

prof.page.stores.withdrawKept.source: The Stores have your order and will send it when the counting-house answers.

prof.page.stores.withdrawNote.source: A withdrawn material becomes an item in your pack and can't go back into the Stores. Writs are delivered on a Notice Board's Work tab.

prof.page.tile.hint.source: Click a station to see where to use it.

prof.page.today.harvests.source: Today: {n, plural, one {# harvest} other {# harvests}}

prof.page.unlocks.herbalism1.source: Common herbs, and the Basket's food

prof.page.unlocks.hunting2.source: Bat Leather, Bear Hide, Wolf Pelt, Boar Hide

prof.page.unlocks.jewelcrafting6.source: The Wand, in Ironwood or Ghostwood

prof.page.unlocks.masonry2.source: Mortar, from Sulphur, Lead and Rough Stone

prof.page.unlocks.outfitting5.source: Hardened Leather armor; Standard-bearer's Silk clothing (its silk comes with the sieges)

prof.page.unlocks.smithing1.source: Iron; the Wood-Axe, Pick-Axe, Sickle and Skinning Knife

prof.reticle.fish.wind.source: hold {key} to wind the net, let go to throw it ({m} m)

prof.reticle.trace.draw.source: draw the knife along the line

prof.witness.far.source: Witnessed ground - zoom in to see

prof.witness.show.source: Show witnessed ground, where every vein, gem and pearl can appear

prof.work.comm.done.source: Commissioned from {crafter}. The pay is held until it is filled, withdrawn or declined.

prof.work.comm.said.source: Holds {pay} for 7 days. The crafter gets it, less {tax} tax, for an unworn piece they made. Up to {n} at a time.

prof.work.contract.full.source: The guild has {n} contracts posted already.

prof.work.contract.how.source: Hit a raider in a town here and stay until the town is cleansed. You are paid when the raid is counted, less {tax} tax.

prof.work.contract.need.source: {guild} pays the defenders of {region}'s towns against raiders

prof.work.contract.ownGuild.source: Officers and the Guildmaster are not paid by their own guild's contracts.

prof.work.declined.source: Declined. Its pay goes back to its poster.

prof.work.fill.blocked.source: Your piece for it is equipped, locked or bound. Free it first.

prof.work.fill.filled.source: Filled: {piece} is on its way to {poster}; {paid}.

prof.work.fill.filledNone.source: Filled: {piece} is on its way to its poster; {paid}.

prof.work.fill.none.source: You carry no unworn piece you made for it.

prof.work.fill.pieceLabel.source: The piece to fill {name}{endsInS, select, yes {''} other {''s}} commission with

prof.work.fill.pieceLabelNone.source: The piece to fill its poster's commission with

prof.work.left.days.source: {n, plural, one {{n, number} day left} other {{n, number} days left}}

prof.work.left.hours.source: {n, plural, one {{n, number} hour left} other {{n, number} hours left}}

prof.work.noBudget.source: The Guildmaster has set no writ budget for Officers this week.

prof.work.paidTax.source: {pay} struck to your account ({tax} tax taken)

prof.work.pastBudget.source: That is past your writ budget this week ({left} left).

prof.work.seat.campNone.source: the Siege Camp at the seat

prof.work.seat.campNoneCap.source: The Siege Camp at the seat

prof.work.withdrawnGuild.source: Withdrawn. The unpaid silver is back in the guild's treasury.

prof.work.writ.full.source: The guild has {n} writs posted already.

prof.work.writ.guildFull.source: The guild's Stores can take no more of it.

prof.work.writ.noneCarried.source: You have none in your Stores, Materials Bag or pack.

prof.work.writ.noneHeld.source: Your Stores hold none of it.

prof.work.writ.ownGuild.source: Officers and the Guildmaster do not deliver to their own guild's writs.

prof.work.writ.said.source: Holds {escrow} of the treasury's {held} for up to 7 days. At most {most} each.

prof.work.writ.walled.source: {n, number} {material} you hold can't fill a writ. Only what you gathered or bought with silver counts.

prof.work.yours.collect.source: filled. Collect it at the Market tab

prof.work.yours.commGone.source: You commissioned a crafter whose account is gone: {piece}, {pay}

prof.work.yours.contract.source: {guild}: {pay} to each of {n, plural, one {{n, number} defender} other {{n, number} defenders}} more

prof.work.yours.fillAbove.source: Fill it on its card above.

ql.journal.ladderChoiceWhy.source: A quest marked “{tag}” asks you to choose, and ends differently for each choice.

ql.journal.ladderLead.source: A guild’s own quests, by the rank that opens them. Each rank is a promotion.

ql.journal.ladderRow.source: Your guild’s quests, rank by rank

ql.journal.lineRetry.source: Its last step failed: it will be offered again

ql.journal.lineShelved.source: Its step is set aside in your journal

ql.journal.lineStepsLabel.source: The steps of this questline, in order

ql.journal.lineTitle.source: Finish it to earn the title {title}, held by your account.

ql.journal.lineTitleEarned.source: This questline earns the title {title}, held by your account.

ql.journal.lineTitleWaits.source: The title {title} waits until the account service has seen every deed this questline asks.

ql.journal.lineWhat.source: A questline is a story told in several quests, one after another. Each step is given when the last one ends.

ql.journal.offerLead.source: Choose one piece. The others are gone once you take it.

ql.journal.reward.source: Finish it to choose one of {n} pieces of gear fitted to you ({floor}), beside its own reward.

ql.journal.stepUnseenWhy.source: Not yet seen: the account service has no record of that deed since this questline began. Do it again and it will count.

ql.journal.stepWitnessedTitle.source: A witnessed step is done in a Dagon’s Breach, an Elite Breach’s Redoubts, the Abyss Dungeon’s Shattered Hour, against the Sea Serpent or at a fallen star. The account service checks it against that place’s own record before it pays.

ql.journal.takeTitle.source: Take {name}: it is set at your feet and your pack opens over it

ql.journal.toDoLabel.source: What this quest asks of you

ql.line.burningDoors.giver.source: Ysolde Marnhel, Master Conjurer of the Mages Guild of Wayrest

ql.line.burningDoors.lead.source: Someone is opening Dagon’s Breaches on purpose. A Master Conjurer of the Mages Guild wants to know who, and how.

ql.line.covensHoard.giver.source: Ysolde Marnhel, Master Conjurer of the Mages Guild of Wayrest

ql.line.covensHoard.lead.source: Dagon’s covens hoard the Battlespire’s keys in the deep places. Their champions glow gold.

ql.line.honourKey.source: A Weir Key is yours: it waits with your keys.

ql.line.honourKeyHeld.source: The Covens’ Hoard gives one Weir Key to an account, and yours was given already.

ql.line.hourThatWasNot.giver.source: Prior Anselm Vey of the Order of the Hour

ql.line.hourThatWasNot.lead.source: The priests of Akatosh feel a wound in time under the Bay, and brass where there should be stone.

ql.line.introArena.lead.source: The Arena’s Herald is calling for new blood, and pays the first purse in advance of glory.

ql.line.introBay.lead.source: A captain of the watch has more trouble than soldiers: raiders on the roads, and the dead who will not lie down.

ql.line.introCrafts.lead.source: A crafter who works for the court wants an apprentice who can find their own materials.

ql.line.introFirmament.lead.source: An astrologer insists your fortune is written on the Firmament, and that you can write the rest yourself.

ql.line.introGear.lead.source: An armorer offers to show you what a good piece of gear can still be made into.

ql.line.introRoad.lead.source: A stable master knows a merchant yard that pays well for a wagon’s load, if someone will haul it.

ql.line.introSea.lead.source: A harbormaster needs a captain. Any captain. Even you.

ql.line.introTables.lead.source: A tavern regular is looking for someone new to lose to. Or, better, to beat.

ql.line.oldCoil.giver.source: Hamid al-Rasheen, a packet captain of Sentinel

ql.line.oldCoil.lead.source: Sentinel’s sailors say the World-Skin was shed once, and that what was shed still swims.

ql.line.stalled.source: Its next step could not begin here: it will be offered again.

ql.line.thirteenthFrostfall.giver.source: Morwen, a Wyrd Sister of Glenmoril

ql.line.thirteenthFrostfall.lead.source: At the Witches’ Festival the covens sing stars out of the sky. A witch of Glenmoril wants to know why.

ql.line.weirRoad.giver.source: Corvane Tull, Battlemage of the Spire’s last class

ql.line.weirRoad.lead.source: The Battlespire fell in 3E 398. One of its last class of Battlemages has never stopped living that year.

ql.reward.dropped.source: Too many rewards wait: the one for {title} is gone.

ql.reward.goldSettled.source: You receive {gold} more gold pieces for how it ended.

ql.reward.waitingClassic.source: A reward waits for {title}: in the pause menu, press Controls, then Escape, and choose it under Quests.

ql.reward.waitingPause.source: A reward waits for {title}: choose it under Quests in the pause menu.

quest.offer.questorBusy.source: You have not finished the work you were given here: {quest}.

quest.offer.questorBusyAbandon.source: If you cannot finish it, you can abandon it from the Quests tab of the pause menu.

quest.offer.questorBusyAbandonClassic.source: If you cannot finish it, you can abandon it: in the pause menu, press Controls, then Escape, and choose it under Quests.

quest.offer.questorBusyUnnamed.source: You have not finished the work you were given here.

quest.possessedChild.shamTrail.source: No daedra came out of _child_ when I brought the _item_. _child_ just thanked me and ran off with it. Something is not right here. _guardian_ was staying at _tavern_, and someone there may know more.

quest.repair.elsewhere.source: Your quest's targets in this dungeon are only in your own instance. Leave and enter again, choosing Your instance.

quest.share.gone.source: That quest is no longer active.

quest.share.guild.source: are not a member of the guild this quest requires.

quest.share.guildNamed.source: are not a member of {guild}, which this quest requires.

quest.share.mainQuest.source: The main quest cannot be shared.

quest.share.mismatch.source: received a quest that did not match your own copy.

quest.share.notNow.source: Could not share that quest right now.

quest.share.notReceived.source: Could not receive the quest "{quest}" from {who}.

quest.share.questline.source: A questline is your own road. Its steps cannot be shared.

quest.share.questline.receiver.source: cannot be given a step of a questline. Each player walks their own.

quest.share.receiver.gone.source: no longer have a copy of it to bring up to date.

quest.share.receiver.mainQuest.source: cannot be given the main quest.

quest.share.receiver.restore.source: could not rebuild it in your world.

quest.share.receiver.shelved.source: have abandoned it. Reclaim it from the Quests tab of the pause menu to take it up again.

quest.share.receiver.tooLarge.source: were sent a quest too large to read.

quest.share.repute.source: do not yet have the standing with its guild this quest asks for.

quest.share.skewDiffer.source: You are on different versions of the game. Both of you should reload the page.

quest.share.skewOld.source: Their game is out of date. They should reload the page.

quest.share.tooLarge.source: This quest is too complex to share.

quest.story.againArmed.source: Click again to take it up

quest.story.againDone.source: {name} begins again from its first step. The main story can go on.

quest.story.againTitle.source: Start this step of the main story again from the beginning, so the story can go on

quest.story.stalled.source: This step of the main story ended before the story could go on.

quest.where.offMapPastBay.source: Beyond the Iliac Bay, past the edge of your map.

raid.ask.defend.source: Keep the Standard-Bearer of {town} alive in the square.

raid.ask.escort.source: Refugees flee to the square of {town}. See them there safely.

raid.ask.waves.source: They come in waves. Hold until their leader falls.

raid.bearerFell.source: The standard of {town} has fallen! The raiders sack the town.

raid.held.source: {town} is held - its people will not forget it.

raid.leaderCharge.source: The {name} leads the last charge on {town}!

raid.refugeeSafe.source: A refugee reaches the square ({n} of {of} safe).

realm.held.budget.source: The realm is reviewing this character: its wealth grew faster than play could earn it. Its trading, gathering and crafting are frozen until play catches up.

realm.held.law.source: The realm is reviewing this character: it carries an item the game could not have made. Its trading, gathering and crafting are frozen until it is gone. Holds add up: from the third, the freeze stays for a week even after it is gone, and for a month each time after that.

realm.held.lawNamed.source: The realm is reviewing this character: it carries a {name} the game could not have made. Its trading, gathering and crafting are frozen until it is gone. Holds add up: from the third, the freeze stays for a week even after it is gone, and for a month each time after that.

realm.held.open.source: This character's trading, gathering and crafting are open again.

realm.held.staff.source: The realm's staff have frozen this character's trading, gathering and crafting. To ask why, send them a private report with /bug, or ask on the game's Discord.

realm.held.until.source: This character has been held 3 times. Its trading, gathering and crafting are frozen until {date}, then reopen on their own.

realm.held.untilPiece.source: This character has been held 3 times, the last over a {name} it carries. Its trading, gathering and crafting are frozen until {date}, and after that until the {name} is gone.

realm.locked.line.source: Locked by the realm. It stays with you and cannot be dropped, traded, sold or stored where others can take it.

realm.locked.many.source: The realm has locked {n, number} of your pieces: it found the same pieces somewhere else too. They stay with you and cannot be traded, sold, dropped or stored where others can take them. Your other pieces and your trading are not affected.

realm.locked.manyNamed.source: The realm has locked {n, number} of your pieces ({list}): it found the same pieces somewhere else too. They stay with you and cannot be traded, sold, dropped or stored where others can take them. Your other pieces and your trading are not affected.

realm.locked.named.source: The realm has locked your {name}: it found the same piece somewhere else too. It stays with you and cannot be traded, sold, dropped or stored where others can take it. Your other pieces and your trading are not affected.

realm.locked.one.source: The realm has locked one of your pieces: it found the same piece somewhere else too. It stays with you and cannot be traded, sold, dropped or stored where others can take it. Your other pieces and your trading are not affected.

realm.locked.refusal.source: {name} is locked by the realm because the same piece was found somewhere else too. It stays with you and cannot be dropped, traded, sold or stored where others can take it.

realm.locked.trade.source: A piece the realm locked cannot be traded.

reforge.imbue.ask.source: Imbue {name} to {tier}? Its lines are rolled fresh.

reforge.imbue.none.source: Nothing in your pack can be imbued. Imbue takes plain weapons, armour, jewellery and clothing, and Magic pieces you found.

reforge.imbue.refused.source: The guild will not imbue that.

reforge.imbue.sub.source: Raise a plain piece to Magic, or a Magic piece to Rare. Its lines are rolled fresh. Shops still pay only what the piece was worth before.

reforge.refusal.cursed.source: Have the temple lift its curse first

report.bodyHint.source: What happens, where, and the steps that make it happen again.

report.bodyLabel.source: What happens, and how to make it happen

report.intro.source: Found an exploit, a bug or a security hole? Tell the developers here, and only they can read it. Please keep exploits out of chat, Discord and the Notice Board until they are fixed.

report.kind.bugHint.source: something that does not work as it should

report.kind.exploitHint.source: something players could abuse: gold or items from nothing, a duplicate, a way past a limit

report.kind.securityHint.source: a way into someone else's account, saves or the servers

report.mineError.source: Your reports could not be read right now.

report.notice.source: {n, plural, one {# private report is waiting to be read.} other {# private reports are waiting to be read.}} Type /mail, or open the mailbox beside the hourglass, then click Private reports.

report.openFailed.source: This report could not be opened.

report.sends.source: Sent with it: your username and this game's build ({build}).

report.sent.source: Sent. Thank you. Only the developers can read it.

report.sentBefore.source: That report had already reached the developers. Thank you.

report.signIn.source: Sign in to an account to send a private report.

resurrect.forGood.source: {name} has fallen for good. No spell will raise them now.

rocket.ebb.source: The frenzy passes, and the mounds sink back into the earth.

rocket.erupt.source: The mounds erupt and shoot poop into the sky!

rocket.foals.source: Little horses follow it, farting all the way!

rocket.frenzy.source: Daggerfall erupts into a giant diarrhea frenzy!

rocket.great.source: A great horse gallops across the sky, neighing and farting!

rocket.lull.source: The poop subsides. Daggerfall holds its breath.

rocket.rise.source: The ground of Daggerfall rumbles. Mounds push up out of the earth.

rvn.art.call.channel.source: Strike it to break the spell!

rvn.art.hunt.barrageCount.source: Art: {n} - {count} blasts at your feet, one after another. Keep moving{below}.

rvn.art.hunt.mending.source: Art: {n} - when hurt, it gathers itself to heal. Strike it to break the spell{below}.

rvn.art.hunt.novaRing.source: Art: {n} - a ring bursts where it stands. Step out of it, or into its center{below}.

rvn.art.hunt.siphon.source: Art: {n} - a beam that drains your life. Step out of its line{below}.

rvn.art.hunt.warcry.source: Art: {n} - it roars as the fight begins, and it and its band strike harder. Strike it to cut the roar short{below}.

rvn.art.hunt.warding.source: Art: {n} - when hurt, it raises a ward against your blows. Strike it to break the spell{below}.

rvn.art.sworn.barrage.source: Art: {n} - now and then it looses a barrage on its foe.

rvn.art.sworn.mendingSecs.source: Art: {n} - when you fall under {at} of your health it heals {share} of it (every {s} seconds).

rvn.art.sworn.nova.source: Art: {n} - now and then it strikes every foe about it.

rvn.art.sworn.roars.source: {given} roars, and your arm grows stronger.

rvn.art.sworn.siphonShare.source: Art: {n} - now and then it draws its foe's life and gives you {share} of it.

rvn.art.sworn.warcry.source: Art: {n} - as it goes into a fight your Strength rises by {points} (every {s} seconds).

rvn.art.sworn.warding.source: Art: {n} - as it goes into a fight it shields you for {points} (every {s} seconds).

rvn.errand.backHurt.source: Back, hurt, from {place} with {haul}. It must recover.

rvn.errand.haul.pieces.source: {k, plural, one {a piece of gear} other {# pieces of gear}}

rvn.errand.no.most.source: {n} of your sworn are abroad already, the most allowed at once.

rvn.gear.no.abroad.source: It is abroad with its kit.

rvn.gear.no.both.source: It must rise to Rank {rank} to bear a {tier} piece of {metal}.

rvn.gear.no.kind.source: {kind} wields no weapon and wears no armor, only a charm.

rvn.gear.no.metal.source: It must rise to Rank {rank} to bear {metal}.

rvn.gear.no.pack.source: It is not in your pack.

rvn.gear.no.quest.source: A quest item stays with you.

rvn.gear.no.shieldAlone.source: Give it a one-handed weapon first.

rvn.gear.no.summoned.source: A summoned piece fades in any hand but yours.

rvn.gear.no.tier.source: It must rise to Rank {rank} to bear a {tier} piece.

rvn.gear.no.use.source: It can only use a melee weapon, armor or a charm.

rvn.roster.abroadLaw.source: Danger runs from I to V. Its rank and gear improve its odds. Its haul goes to your purse, your pack and your Materials Bag. A hard-won mission brings back {pct}% of the haul, and it must rest after. Up to {n} can be abroad at once.

rvn.roster.abroadLived.source: Online, a mission keeps real time: it goes on while you're away, {h, plural, one {# real hour} other {# real hours}} for each day abroad. Resting, waiting or traveling doesn't speed it up.

rvn.roster.dest.source: {place} - {days, plural, one {a day} other {# days}}, danger {danger}

rvn.roster.gearTip.source: Give it a weapon, armor or a charm from your pack

rvn.roster.giveTip.source: It wears this from now on. You can take it back at any time.

rvn.roster.heldOff.source: Not worn: it needs an unbroken one-handed weapon

rvn.roster.kitCaps.source: At Rank {rank} it can wear up to {metal} and {tier} pieces. An empty slot keeps its own gear.

rvn.roster.kitCharm.source: {kind} can't use weapons or armor, but it can wear a charm.

rvn.roster.kitOdds.source: On a mission, its gear adds {pct}% to its odds (up to {max}%).

rvn.roster.missionTip.source: Send it abroad and it comes back with a haul

rvn.roster.nothingToGive.source: Nothing in your pack that it could wear.

rvn.roster.recallAsk.source: Recall {name}? It returns now with nothing and must rest.

rvn.roster.sendTip.source: It leaves for {place} on a {venture} errand

rvn.roster.starsLeft.source: Level {level} · {n, plural, one {a star} other {# stars}} to set

rvn.roster.starsNone.source: Level {level} · no stars to set yet

rvn.roster.starsTip.source: Spend its star points on health, damage, its art and missions

rvn.roster.takeBackShield.source: Its shield comes back with it

rvn.stars.art.awakened.source: Its art: {art}, awakened by its stars. The Grave makes it stronger and quicker.

rvn.stars.art.born.source: Its art: {art}. The Grave makes it stronger and quicker.

rvn.stars.art.none.source: It was born without an art. Awakened Art would teach it {art}.

rvn.stars.graveLore.source: Its art: how strong it is, how often it can use it, and an art for a revenant born without one.

rvn.stars.hint.source: Click a star to take it and the stars on the way to it · Right-click to remove · Drag to pan · Scroll to zoom · H: back to the Oath

rvn.stars.hintTouch.source: Tap a star to see it, tap again to take it · Hold a star to remove it · Drag to pan · Pinch to zoom

rvn.stars.levelTip.source: It earns experience from fights won at your side (more for stronger enemies) and from missions it returns from.

rvn.stars.levelUp.source: {given} reaches level {level}. Set its new {n, plural, one {star} other {# stars}} on the Companions page.

rvn.stars.no.abroad.source: It's away on a mission. Set its stars when it returns.

rvn.stars.no.pointsAfter.source: Reaching this star costs {need} {need, plural, one {point} other {points}}. It has {left}. It gets one point per level after the first, and one per rank past the first.

rvn.stars.no.way.source: This star isn't connected to any star it has taken.

rvn.stars.noPointsAfter.source: It gains one point for each level after the first. It earns experience from fights won at your side and from missions.

rvn.stars.none.source: No stars taken yet. Start next to the Oath.

rvn.stars.note.source: Changing its stars is free, but not while it's away. Its health and damage change at once.

rvn.stars.pointsTip.source: One point per level after the first, and one per rank past the first.

rvn.stars.roadLore.source: Missions and loyalty: mission odds, loot, travel time, loyalty and rest.

rvn.stars.stat.awaken.source: Learns an art of its kind, if it was born without one

rvn.stars.stat.bold.source: Brings back nothing if it returns hurt

rvn.stars.stat.hasteShorter.source: Its art can be used again {n} sooner

rvn.stars.tip.backAfter.source: Right-click to remove it and {n, plural, one {the star} other {the # stars}} after it.

rvn.stars.tip.oath.source: Every sworn revenant starts with the Oath. Take a star next to it.

rvn.stars.tip.take.source: Click to take: {n} {n, plural, one {point} other {points}}.

rvn.stars.unaccepted.source: You have unaccepted changes. Press {accept} to keep them, or close again to discard them.

rvn.stars.unacceptedLeave.source: You have unaccepted changes. Press {accept} to keep them, or leave again to discard them.

rvn.sworn.gone.source: It is no longer sworn to you.

rvn.took.home.source: {name} could not keep your {item}. It is back in your pack.

rvn.unq.amb.masteryDo.source: it trains while it waits, and grows bolder every 2 days instead of 3

rvn.unq.amb.plunderDo.source: it raids the roads while it waits, and grows richer the longer you leave it

rvn.unq.amb.vengeanceDo.source: it comes for you sooner, and more often

rvn.unq.ascended.source: {given} will run no more. It is the Dread now, and waits for you in {lair}.

rvn.unq.craft.blinkDo.source: it tears open a rift and is gone. Silence it, hold it, or strike it as it fades

rvn.unq.craft.boltDo.source: it runs faster than anything you have chased. Bring it down from range, and break its will before the killing blow

rvn.unq.craft.sinkDo.source: it sinks into the earth. Strike it before it is under, and it rises, cornered, and runs no more

rvn.unq.craft.smokeDo.source: it throws down smoke and vanishes as it runs, but a blow can still find it

rvn.unq.escape.source: Got away. It will remember this.

rvn.unq.escapeRank.source: Got away and rose to rank {rank}. It will remember this.

rvn.unq.escapeWound.source: It bears the wound you left: {wound}.

rvn.unq.fester.mastery.source: {given} grows bolder. It has been training.

rvn.unq.flee.blink.source: {given} tears open a rift. Strike it before it is through!

rvn.unq.flee.sink.source: {given} sinks into the earth. Strike it before it is under!

rvn.unq.flee.smoke.source: {given} throws down smoke and is lost to sight!

rvn.unq.hunt.dread.source: The Dread will not come to you again. Go to it.

rvn.unq.hunt.trail.source: Weakened, it went to ground here to recover. It will be whole again in {hours, plural, one {# hour} other {# hours}}.

rvn.unq.omen.mastery.source: Word reaches you that {given} is ready to face you again.

rvn.unq.omen.plunder.source: Travelers speak of {given} on the roads again. It is coming for you.

rvn.unq.omen.vengeance.source: You feel eyes on your back. {given} is hunting you again.

rvn.unq.page.blood.source: If it kills you once more, or fells one more companion, it grows bolder.

rvn.unq.page.craftYoung.source: Its flight: it runs. From rank {rank} it will break away in its own way.

rvn.unq.page.dreadCome.source: It waits for you in {lair} and will not come to you again. Go to it.

rvn.unq.page.dreadStand.source: Last stands: twice in a fight it rises again, at {first}% and at {second}% of its health.

rvn.unq.page.dreadWill.source: At home it has nowhere to run: it never flees, and kneels at the end.

rvn.unq.page.heals.source: The oldest heals in {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} unless you find it first.

rvn.unq.page.how.source: An elite or champion marked Unquiet that escapes you, or kills you, will remember you and come back for you.

rvn.unq.page.howHeld.source: From Renown {renown}, an elite or champion marked Unquiet that escapes you, or kills you, will remember you and come back for you.

rvn.unq.page.noneYet.source: No foe has earned your name yet.

rvn.unq.page.tears.source: If its will holds at your killing blow once more, it grows bolder.

rvn.unq.page.woundedCome.source: Recovering in {lair}, whole again in {hours, plural, one {# hour} other {# hours}}. Find it there.

rvn.unq.rumor.dread.source: They say {name} has gone to ground in {lair}, and that nobody who goes in comes out.

rvn.unq.rumor.mastery.source: Word is it trains day and night for the day it meets you again.

rvn.unq.rumor.plunder.source: Word is it has been raiding the roads.

rvn.unq.rumor.vengeance.source: Word is it asks after you by name.

rvn.unq.slip.source: You hesitated. {given} got away, and it will remember.

rvn.unq.trail.source: Its trail leads to {lair}, where it has gone to ground to recover. Catch it before it is whole again.

rvn.unq.trained.source: {given} has been training. It has learned to answer your {how}.

rvn.unq.wound.bledDo.source: a wound that will not close, so it has less health

rvn.unq.wound.crackedDo.source: cracked bones, so it staggers more easily

rvn.unq.wound.lamedDo.source: a lamed leg, so it runs slower

rvn.unq.wound.maimedDo.source: a maimed hand, so its blows are lighter

saddle.note.failing.source: The {wagon} is failing. Mend it to restore its pace

saddle.note.load.source: Overloaded. Your team pulls it more slowly

saddle.note.rickety.source: The {wagon} is rickety. A repair kit or a Wagon Yard will mend it

saddle.note.starvingGallop.source: Starving. It will not gallop until it eats

saddle.note.winded.source: Winded. Ease off and let it breathe

schools.battlemage.passiveText.source: While your Shield holds, your damage spells deal {pct}% more damage.

schools.battlemage.rider.source: Gives you a Shield worth {times} times the damage dealt (up to {most}% of your health) for {rounds} rounds.

schools.bloodmage.passiveText.source: Your damage spells deal 1% more damage for every {per}% of health you are missing, up to {most}%.

schools.bloodmage.rider.source: If the target is below {pct}% health after the hit, it takes the same damage again.

schools.choice.others.source: {n, plural, one {# other specialization is open to you.} other {# other specializations are open to you.}}

schools.choice.reset.source: Resetting it later costs {gold, number} gold.

schools.declined.source: You can choose a specialization later in your skill screen.

schools.declinedGrowth.source: You can choose a specialization later on the Growth tab of the pause menu.

schools.elementalist.passiveText.source: Each of your damage spells that hits adds {pct}% to your spell damage for {seconds} seconds, building up to {stacks} times.

schools.elementalist.rider.source: Jumps to up to {foes} other enemies within {metres} meters, dealing {pct}% of the damage.

schools.enchanter.rider.source: If it calms the target, its magicka cost is refunded.

schools.hierophant.passiveText.source: When damage drops you below {below}% health, you heal {pct}% of your health. This can happen once every {minutes} minutes.

schools.hierophant.rider.source: Gives you {pct}% Spell Resistance for {rounds} rounds.

schools.lightbringer.passiveText.source: Your damage spells deal {pct}% more damage to undead and daedra.

schools.lightbringer.rider.source: Heals you for {heal}% of the damage dealt. Undead and daedra take an extra {burn}% of the damage.

schools.necromancer.passiveText.source: Each kill restores {health}% of your health and {magicka}% of your magicka.

schools.necromancer.rider.source: Heals you for {pct}% of the damage dealt.

schools.open.count.source: {n, plural, one {# specialization is open to you:} other {# specializations are open to you:}}

schools.open.where.source: Choose one in your skill screen.

schools.open.whereGrowth.source: See them all and choose one on the Growth tab of the pause menu.

schools.riftwalker.rider.source: Other enemies within {metres} meters of the target take {pct}% of the damage.

schools.say.foresight.source: Foresight: you saw the blow coming.

schools.say.slipAway.source: Slip Away: you fade from sight.

schools.seer.passiveText.source: One enemy blow in {n} misses you.

schools.seer.rider.source: For {seconds} seconds, the target's saving throws against your damage spells are {points} lower.

schools.shadowcaster.passiveText.source: While you have Invisibility, Chameleon or Shadow, your damage spells deal {pct}% more damage.

schools.shadowcaster.rider.source: On a hit, you gain Shadow for {rounds} rounds.

schools.sheet.next.source: {n, plural, one {# specialization is open. Choose No, then press S to see the next.} other {# specializations are open. Choose No, then press S to see the next.}}

schools.sheet.sold.source: Its signature spell is sold to you at the Mages Guild.

schools.soulbinder.passiveText.source: Each kill restores {pct}% of your magicka ({trapped}% if your Soul Trap was on the target).

schools.soulbinder.rider.source: Restores magicka equal to {pct}% of the damage dealt.

schools.spellbreaker.passiveText.source: Enemies' saving throws against your damage spells are {points} lower.

schools.spellbreaker.rider.source: On a hit, refunds {pct}% of its magicka cost.

schools.trickster.passiveText.source: When damage drops you below {pct}% health, you turn invisible for {rounds} rounds. This can happen once every {minutes} minutes.

schools.trickster.rider.source: If it takes hold, you gain Chameleon for {rounds} rounds.

schools.warden.passiveText.source: While your Shield holds, you regain {pct}% of your health each round.

schools.warden.rider.source: For {seconds} seconds, enemy blows deal {pct}% less damage to you.

schools.wardwright.passiveText.source: Your Alteration and Thaumaturgy spells cost {pct}% less magicka.

schools.wardwright.rider.source: For {seconds} seconds, each Destruction spell that hits you has a {pct}% chance to be absorbed, if you have room for the magicka.

sd.timers.broken.source: Its Hour is broken. It collapses when this runs out

sd.timers.fades.source: Found. It fades away unbeaten when this runs out

sd.timers.watch.source: Not before this. Watch {province} for its brass omen

sea.board.cargoVoid.source: Contract void - {title}. No ship can make port there.

sea.bounty.asking.source: The harbormaster is reading the board...

sea.bounty.collected.source: You collect {gold} gold in bounties. It is in your account here.

sea.bounty.lede.source: Gold posted on a captain's head is paid to whoever ends them at sea: a death at their hand, or a wreck at their guns. Each post is your own gold.

sea.bounty.mine.source: A bounty of {gold} gold stands on your own head.

sea.bounty.none.source: No captain of the open sea is wanted.

sea.bounty.owed.source: {gold} gold for the wanted captains you ended at sea.

sea.bounty.posted.source: You post {gold} gold on {name}'s head. The bounty stands at {bounty} gold.

sea.bounty.refund.source: {gold} gold you posted on captains who are gone, back to you.

sea.bounty.row.source: {kills, plural, =0 {No kills at sea of late} one {# kill at sea} other {# kills at sea}} - {gold} gold on their head

sea.bounty.short.source: You do not have {gold} gold to post.

sea.chart.canvas.source: A chart of {sea}: your ship, the isles you have charted, the depths, the Veil and the legends' haunts

sea.chart.hint.source: Drag or use the arrow keys to pan. Scroll, pinch or press + and - to zoom. C finds your ship. Point at or tap an isle to see its name.

sea.chart.key.peace.source: Veilhaven's peace - past it, open PvP

sea.chart.key.vault.source: A vault of the deep, open today

sea.chart.ruler.veilHome.source: THE VEIL: TO THE ILIAC BAY

sea.chart.stats.source: {charted, plural, one {# isle} other {# isles}} charted - deepest {deepest} leagues past the Veil - {crossings, plural, one {# crossing} other {# crossings}}

sea.chart.statsLegends.source: {charted, plural, one {# isle} other {# isles}} charted · deepest {deepest} leagues past the Veil · {crossings, plural, one {# crossing} other {# crossings}} · {legends, plural, one {# legend} other {# legends}} ended

sea.fleet.sails.source: A treasure fleet weighs anchor ({band}): the {ship} and her escorts, bound east. It lies to the {way}.

sea.fleet.scattered.source: The treasure fleet's flagship has gone down. The fleet scatters.

sea.fleet.sunk.source: The {ship} is sunk! {gold} gold floats up from her strongroom.

sea.fleet.taken.source: The {ship} is taken! {gold} gold from her strongroom.

sea.pvp.back.source: {n, plural, one {# piece} other {# pieces}} of your hold, never collected by the captain who boarded you.

sea.pvp.boarded.source: You come alongside {name}'s wreck and board her. Her hold is open to you.

sea.pvp.holdBack.source: Goods your killer never collected are back in your pack: {n, plural, one {# piece} other {# pieces}}.

sea.pvp.holdShut.source: Her hold is shut while her wreck may be boarded.

sea.pvp.holdSpared.source: Your wreck was boarded, but nothing in her hold was worth the taking.

sea.pvp.holdTaken.source: Your wreck was boarded and her hold plundered: {n, plural, one {# piece} other {# pieces}} taken.

sea.pvp.notBoarded.source: You did not board her in time. Her hold stays her captain's.

sea.pvp.prizeTaken.source: Plunder from a wreck's hold is in your pack: {n, plural, one {# piece} other {# pieces}}.

sea.pvp.prizes.source: {n, plural, one {# piece} other {# pieces}} from wrecks you boarded, held for you.

sea.pvp.wrecked.source: Your ship is wrecked by {name}'s guns! She lies crippled.

sea.pvp.wreckedHer.source: {name}'s ship is wrecked! Come alongside and board her for her hold.

sea.rumour.fleet.source: A treasure fleet is under way ({band}): the {ship} and her escorts, {way} of here and bound east. It makes port in {min} minutes.

sea.rumour.fleetNext.source: The next treasure fleet weighs anchor in {min} minutes ({band}), {way} of here.

sea.rumour.storm.source: An Aether storm is blowing {way} of here. It blows itself out in {min} minutes.

sea.rumour.stormNext.source: Sailors say an Aether storm will gather {way} of here in {min} minutes.

sea.season.asking.source: The harbormaster is reading the season's boards...

sea.season.deepNone.source: No captain has sailed past the Veil this season.

sea.season.headSub.source: Season {n} - {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} left

sea.season.lede.source: Every captain of the realm, this season: how far past the Veil they have sailed, and how many of the six legends they have sunk or taken.

sea.season.legendsNone.source: No legend has been sunk or taken this season.

sea.season.mineDeep.source: You are {rank, selectordinal, one {#st} two {#nd} few {#rd} other {#th}} for the deepest voyage ({figure}).

sea.season.mineLegends.source: You are {rank, selectordinal, one {#st} two {#nd} few {#rd} other {#th}} for legends ended ({figure}).

sea.storm.enter.source: You sail into the Aether storm. Lightning seeks the masts, and wrack rides the swell.

sea.storm.gathers.source: An Aether storm gathers to the {way} ({band}).

sea.storm.leave.source: You sail out of the Aether storm.

sea.storm.strikeFire.source: Lightning strikes your ship and sets her alight!

sea.storm.wrack.source: The storm throws up wrack. A cask bobs in the swell alongside.

sea.storm.wrackTidemail.source: In the wrack: {piece}, a piece of {set}!

sea.tidemail.fleet.source: From the treasure fleet's flagship {ship}: {piece}, a piece of {set}!

sea.vault.crows.source: Crows gather over {name} ({band}). Someone has fallen there.

sea.vault.crowsAnon.source: Crows gather over a vault of the deep. Someone has fallen there.

sea.wild.burntLate.source: What you dropped when you died at sea has left your pack. This character's trading is frozen, so it was lost.

sea.wild.crossWarn.source: Past Veilhaven's peace the open sea is an open PvP zone. Other players may attack you there.

sea.wild.leave.source: You are in Veilhaven's peace. No player may attack you here.

sea.wild.quiet.source: You are out of the open {word} Ocean's PvP zone. No player may attack you here.

sea.wild.revenantOne.source: Only one revenant may walk at your side on the open {word} Ocean.

sea.wild.teleport.source: You cannot teleport into, out of or about the open {word} Ocean. Sail.

sea.wild.truce.source: No longer in your party. On the open {word} Ocean you and they cannot fight for ten minutes. Then you are strangers.

sea.wild.unstuckOut.source: /unstuck does not work outdoors on the open {word} Ocean.

season.book.arena.about.source: Rated bouts set your season rating. The leader wears Arena Champion, and the banner with more points wears the laurel next season.

season.book.arena.withBanner.source: {line} - {points, plural, one {# point} other {# points}} for the {banner}

season.book.cakes.about.source: Found on foes, the dead and the summoned most often, and in gathering, crafting, looting and at sea. Spend them with the Wyrd Sister outside any tavern. Finds count double on 31 October (UTC) and on in-game nights the dead walk.

season.book.chapters.about.source: Every chapter draws an event when the Season opens. In a Schism or a Succession, members back a side.

season.book.crowns.about.source: Each crown's guildmaster earns Crowned in Season {n}. The guildmaster of a guild that holds a seat all Season earns Keeper of its town.

season.book.festival.guest.source: Add a username to join the festival.

season.book.festival.signin.source: Sign in to join the festival.

season.book.gambit.about.source: Rated games between registered accounts. The leader wears Grandmaster.

season.book.guest.source: Add a username to be ranked.

season.book.iliac.about.source: Rated games at the card table. The leader wears Iliac Champion.

season.book.ladder.ranked.source: #{rank} - rating {rating} - {games, plural, one {# game} other {# games}}

season.book.ladder.rated.source: Rating {rating} - {games, plural, one {# game} other {# games}}

season.book.noClock.source: The world's clock can't be read right now.

season.book.realm.foot.source: Arena Champion, Iliac Champion and Grandmaster are worn by the leader, once they have {games} rated bouts or games against {foes} different opponents.

season.book.realm.lead.source: Every board here starts fresh each season.

season.book.reset.about.source: Standing drifts halfway back to 50 and every fortification loses a tier. Charters stand.

season.book.ribbon.about.source: Members of a guild that kept a seat all Season wear its ribbon through the next.

season.book.sea.about.source: The deepest voyage past the Veil and the most legends sunk or taken, on the board at any freeport's harbormaster.

season.book.sea.figures.source: Deepest: {leagues, plural, one {# league} other {# leagues}} past the Veil - {legends, plural, one {# legend} other {# legends}} ended

season.book.sea.none.source: No voyage counted yet this season

season.book.seats.foot.source: The Notice Board's Seat tab has the week's standings.

season.book.seats.lead.source: The guilds' war for the towns. A Season ends at its last Sunday Turning.

season.book.seats.trialLead.source: Season 0 is the beta. When it ends, the seats' war is wiped and no one is crowned. Silver, the Stores and your professions stay.

season.book.spire.about.source: Each bracket ranks companies by their deepest Descent from Hall 1. The top ten are Spire Champions next season. A new season lets you start from half your deepest Redoubt.

season.book.starfall.about.source: Every in-game night, about once a real hour, one coven pulls three stars down near its region's towns. Hold the crater against the waves.

season.book.tides.about.source: Each week every kingdom, the Marches and the Free Lands draw a Tide - a harvest, a plague, raiders - or stay Calm.

season.book.unread.source: The board can't be read right now.

season.colossus.falls.source: The Brass Colossus falls, and its heart-bell rings out.

season.colossus.maul.source: You take the Resonant Maul from the wreck.

season.colossus.wakes.source: The Brass Colossus climbs out of the Heart Fissure near {near}.

season.fissure.quiet.source: Quiet while the gate stands beside it.

season.fissure.wakes.source: The Brass Colossus waits below it.

season.tremor.0.source: The ground shudders. Far below, brass grinds on brass.

season.tremor.1.source: The ground heaves. Steam hisses out of cracks in the earth.

season.tremor.2.source: The earth roars. Deep below, something vast is waking.

seat.bounty.denPaid.source: The Bounty pays you {n} silver for the den.

seat.edict.bountyDens.source: Outlaws' hideouts and lairs near the town: the treasury pays {silver} silver a den cleared, from what is set aside.

seat.gift.choice.source: {material}: {stores, number} in your Stores, {bag, number} in your bag

seat.gift.counted.source: It counts as influence for your guild here.

seat.gift.doneCamp.source: You gave {n, number} {material} to the Siege Camp at {seat}.

seat.gift.doneStockpile.source: You gave {n, number} {material} to the stockpile at {seat}.

seat.gift.none.source: You hold none of what it takes, in your Stores or your bag.

seat.gift.ruleCamp.source: Any member may give materials from their Stores or their bag - what they gathered, made or bought with silver, never with gold. The Siege Camp is spent at the Turning on the siege it is raised for, and nothing given comes back. Each unit you gathered or made counts 1 influence a silver of its value for your guild here, as a seat writ's delivery does.

seat.gift.ruleStockpile.source: Any member may give materials from their Stores or their bag - what they gathered, made or bought with silver, never with gold. The works take what they need from the stockpile, and nothing given comes back. Each unit you gathered or made counts 1 influence a silver of its value for your guild here, as a seat writ's delivery does.

seat.gift.uncounted.source: It counts no influence this week: only a member seven days in the guild, whose account fights for it this week, counts.

seat.holding.tab.source: {town} is a holding of {charter}. Its Charter is won, held and besieged at {seat}, and everything given or earned here counts there.

shop.aurum.lineAll.source: Aurum buys every item in the shop and in the Folios. Your deeds find it, the week's deeds pay it, and you can buy it here.

shop.aurum.rules.source: Aurum has no cash value. It cannot be traded, and it buys no power.

shop.bundle.held.source: Owned: its price is taken off

shop.bundle.part.source: Partly owned: its price is less

shop.cosmetic.source: Every item is cosmetic. It gives no power in the game.

shop.deals.line.source: Each costs a quarter less today. New deals come each day at midnight UTC.

shop.deed.line.source: Each deed pays once a week. A new week starts on Monday, UTC.

shop.look.aurbis.source: The wheel of the heavens about Aetherius, its spheres turning in their orbits. It moves.

shop.look.aurumAll.source: Aurum for every item in the shop and in the Folios. It has no cash value and cannot be traded.

shop.look.azurastar.source: Azura's Star turning slowly in the dusk, its heart of light pulsing. It moves.

shop.look.daedricchampion.source: Daedric Dominion, the Daedric Pyre, Eternal Champion and the Oblivion Sigil, together.

shop.look.dawnbringer.source: A title on a plate of gold, rays of dawn rising behind its letters, over your name.

shop.look.dominion.source: A ring of Daedric script burns black and crimson at your feet, embers rising off it. It comes in three bundles.

shop.look.elderscroll.source: An Elder Scroll open between gilded rollers, its script lit line by line. It moves.

shop.look.eternal.source: A cape of blue-violet fire on your back. It flows as you move, and wisps of flame trail behind you.

shop.look.eternalchampion.source: A title on a plate of crimson fire under a gold edge, over your name.

shop.look.gatefire.source: Dagon's Breach between black spires, its fire turning, embers rising. It moves.

shop.look.gatesigil.source: A gate of runes, a spark burning between its pillars. It comes in the Portal Master bundle.

shop.look.genesis.source: A title set on a plate of blue-violet fire that burns behind its letters, over your name.

shop.look.hourglass.source: A gilded hourglass that turns over when its last grain falls. It moves.

shop.look.lordofoblivion.source: The Daedric Warhorse, the Daedric Stone, Daedric Dominion and the Daedric Pyre, together.

shop.look.oblivion.source: A Daedric sigil, its spokes burning crimson round a dark eye. It comes in the Daedric Champion bundle.

shop.look.origin.source: A dragon coiled round on itself, biting its tail, a spark burning at its heart. Light runs round its scales.

shop.look.portalmaster.source: The Daedric Stone, Daedric Dominion and the Gate Sigil, together.

shop.look.redmountain.source: Red Mountain under its ash, lava running down its flanks, smoke rising. It moves.

shop.look.sanguinerose.source: A black-red rose in full bloom, dew on its petals, thorns along its stem.

shop.look.voidwalker.source: A title on a plate of violet void, stars drawn slowly into its dark, over your name.

shop.look.whitegold.source: The White-Gold Tower over the Imperial City and Lake Rumare at dusk.

shop.noPreview.source: This device cannot show the aura here.

shop.noPreviewArmory.source: This device cannot show the piece here.

shop.noPreviewEffect.source: This device cannot show the effect here.

shop.pass.closedFolios.source: The Folios are not open yet.

shop.pass.found.source: Aurum found today: {n, number} of {max, number}

shop.pass.foundLine.source: Deeds find Aurum each day, up to a limit. Challenges pay their Aurum beside it.

shop.pass.freeLine.source: Every registered account can buy from it.

shop.pass.howFolios.source: Spend Aurum on any item of an open page. Each page opens once you spend enough in its folio. The folios never close.

shop.pass.overFolios.source: The season is over, and its challenges with it. Its folios stay open.

shop.pass.pageFolioLocked.source: Unlock this folio to open this page.

shop.pass.pageLocked.source: Spend {n, number} more Aurum in this folio to open this page.

shop.pass.premiumLine.source: Unlock it once with Aurum, then buy its items. It never expires.

shop.pass.premiumOpen.source: Unlocked. It is yours for good.

shop.pass.signInFolios.source: Sign in with a username to buy from the Folios.

shop.proceeds.source: All proceeds go to the costs of developing DFO Online.

shop.stripe.source: Payments are taken by Stripe. Prices are in US dollars, and Stripe can show your own currency and ways to pay. No card details reach the game.

shop.who.closed.source: The shop does not take payments yet.

shop.who.for.source: Purchases go to the account {name}, for every character on it.

shop.who.guest.source: A guest account cannot buy. Add a username from your profile first.

social.guild.castle.none.source: A guild that holds a crown's Charter - Daggerfall, Wayrest, Sentinel or a province's capital, but the Imperial City - may buy its castle for {price, number} silver from the treasury: its own instance of the castle, which only its members can enter. The castle goes with the Charter: if the region is lost, half its price comes home.

social.guild.castle.sold.source: The castle is given up. {back} silver came home.

start.BlackMarsh.body.source: Smugglers seized the Emperor's courier on the road from Helstrom and carried his satchel into a ruin in the marsh. Your sealed orders are in it.

start.Elsweyr.body.source: Bandits took a caravan of Dwemer brass bound for Sentinel, and the Emperor's courier who rode with it. Your sealed orders are somewhere in their hold.

start.IliacBay.body.source: Your ship to Daggerfall goes down in a storm, and you wake in a pirates' cave on the coast. The Emperor's sealed orders were lost in the wreck. The tide may have carried them in.

start.Imperial.body.source: The Blades test the Emperor's agents before they trust them. Your sealed orders lie at the heart of a disused prison near the Imperial City. Bring them out, and you have passed.

start.Imperial.where.source: An old prison near the Imperial City

start.Morrowind.body.source: Diggers near Mournhold broke through into old Dwemer halls and fled what they found. The Emperor's courier went down after them with your sealed orders. Neither came back up.

start.Skyrim.body.source: The Emperor's courier sheltered from a blizzard in an old hall near Solitude, where the dead do not rest. He carried your sealed orders, and he never came out. You go in after him.

start.Sumurset.body.source: A scholar of the Mantella was to hand you the Emperor's sealed orders. She was found dead in the hall near Alinor where she kept her notes, and the orders are still inside.

start.Valenwood.body.source: A wounded Blades courier crawled into a cave near Falinesti to hide from the men hunting her. She carried your sealed orders. Find her.

start.Valenwood.where.source: A cave under the roots near Falinesti

start.noSite.source: No way to that province could be found. Your story begins in the Iliac Bay.

start.page.hint.source: Click one, or up/down and Enter, or press 1 to {n}

start.page.lead.source: Choose where this character wakes. Wherever it is, the Emperor's orders send you to Daggerfall, and the main story begins when you get there.

start.page.shut.source: The land past the Bay is off

survival.boon.mealTip.source: A hearty tavern meal: you stay fed and your thirst is held while it lasts.

tutorials.chapters.body1.source: Online, quests raise your standing with each guild by at most {max} a real day (days start at midnight UTC). Any more is added on later days.

tutorials.chapters.body2.source: Reviews promote you up to rank {cap}. Ranks {officer} and {master} are chapter chairs, won by Merit at each Sunday's Turning. A notice board explains chapters.

tutorials.chapters.trigger.source: When you first come online as a member of a guild, temple or order.

tutorials.characterSheet.skillRaise.source: A used skill goes up when you rest or travel, at most once every 6 hours.

tutorials.characterSheet.skillRaiseStats.source: A used skill goes up when you rest or travel, at most once every 6 hours. Your Stats page shows how close each skill is.

tutorials.crafting.body.source: Online, stand at a station and press {Professions}: the Crafting page opens on it. Cook at any fire.

tutorials.crafting.more.source: Your home can hold stations too. Each crafting profession under {Professions} says more.

tutorials.crafting.shops1.source: Forge: Weaponsmiths, Armorers. Loom: Clothing Stores. Workbench: Furniture Stores, joineries.

tutorials.crafting.shops2.source: Jeweler's bench: Pawn Shops, Gem Stores. Mason's bench: General Stores. Alchemy: Alchemists, Mages Guilds. Enchanting: Mages Guild halls.

tutorials.guilds.body1.source: Join a guild for its services and its work. Do that work and practice the skills it teaches to rise in rank.

tutorials.guilds.body2.source: You may join one temple, one knightly order, and as many guilds as will have you.

tutorials.guilds.online.source: Online, reviews promote you no further than rank {cap}. Ranks {officer} and {master} are chapter chairs; see Guild Chapters.

tutorials.guilds.trigger.source: When you first visit a guild.

tutorials.kingsGambit.body1.source: A game of armies and kings, played on a board laid across a tavern's card table. Choose a regular to play, set down your stake and raise your army.

tutorials.kingsGambit.body2.source: Each turn, move your pieces, strike and drink potions. Bring down the enemy king to win, and guard your own.

tutorials.kingsGambit.trigger.source: When you first sit down to The King's Gambit.

tutorials.questlines.body1.source: The Quests tab lists what each quest asks of you and ticks off each step. Some quests make you choose, and end differently for each choice.

tutorials.questlines.gearBody.source: Some quests, once finished, let you pick one of three pieces of gear: the quest’s page says so. Questlines are longer stories told in several quests, one after another. The same tab lists them.

tutorials.questlines.trigger.source: When you first take a quest with objectives.
